# Shared rules for the class playtest drafts

**Provisional design integration, 8 October 2026.** These rules make the class drafts usable together for testing. They preserve each protected class engine while specifying missing timing and replacing conflicting old percentages. They do not rewrite the approved Word books. Original descriptions and alternate registry entries remain in `data/playtest/class_sources`.

## Reading a class card

Use the class's own level, never total character level, for gates and effects. **L** means that class level; **S** is 1/2/3/4 at class levels1/5/11/17. **M** means max(1, the class ability modifier), for effect amounts only. Attacks use d20 + normal character proficiency + the actual appropriate ability modifier. Class save DC is8 + normal proficiency + actual class ability modifier. Negative modifiers still apply to attacks and DCs. One tile is5ft. Fractions round down unless specified. Distances cannot be negative.

A weapon attack uses its usual ability, weapon die and damage type. A technique that says “make one weapon attack” replaces your Action with that attack; it does not also grant a normal Attack Action or Extra Attack. Generic attack-speed language has no effect beyond the exact attacks printed in the draft. A spell attack uses the class's stated casting ability. Natural1 misses and natural20 hits/critically doubles damage dice; flat bonuses do not double. A save succeeds at DC; “fails by10” means the total is at least10 below DC. Critical-range improvements never stack; use the broadest one.

An ability is known only if granted or selected by the draft schedule. Satisfy all printed prerequisites, target legality, action availability, recharge and resource costs before spending anything. A failed legal attack/save attempt still pays; an illegal activation spends nothing. No resource goes below0 or above its cap. A class feature name shared with a spell does not grant both versions; use the version selected, with its own cost and timing. Names and source text are preserved; the current card is the operational draft.

## Action and timing limits

One regular Action, one Bonus Action if a feature permits it, normal movement and one Reaction between starts of your turns. A free trigger costs no Action only if expressly stated. All grants share **one extra full Action per creature per round**. An extra Action cannot grant another Action, recharge itself, or start another extra-Action grant. It supplies no extra Bonus Action or Reaction. A card granting additional attacks is not permission to repeat all class riders on every hit: obey each rider's frequency.

Recharge N sets a counter toN after use; reduce once at the start of the owner's regular initiative turn, whether able to act or not. Extra turns/Actions do not tick it. Outside combat tick once per6 elapsed seconds, without double counting. Recharge2 used on turn1 is ready on turn3. A positive counter can be reset/shortened at most once per ability per round. Zero counters are not legal reset targets and expend no reset use. Resets never restore RP or per-rest uses or grant an immediate activation.

An encounter is a genuine scene of uncertain opposition chosen by the Director, not a player declaration used to reset resources. No encounter gain from attacking allies, one's summons, harmless animals, helpless captives or reused corpses. Out-of-combat abilities retain all printed costs and time. Short-rest means a completed uninterrupted hour of permitted recovery; long-rest means a completed8-hour Rest Watch. This time convention is a draft integration. Expedition pressure, supplies, safe locations and rest debt still matter. A long rest also refreshes short-rest uses; a short rest never refreshes long-rest uses. Weekly uses refresh after seven full in-world days, not repeated rests.

## Targets, concentration and control

Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. A list cannot contain a creature twice. Select up to the printed limit; an empty target list is not a valid way to farm activation benefits. Zones remain at their chosen point unless described as an aura; allies can leave and lose their benefits. An aura requires its owner conscious unless the card supplies a bounded exception. An effect ending at “end next turn” means the affected creature's next turn only when the card says target's; otherwise the user's.

One concentration slot for all spells, Chants, Veinweaves, forms or zones that require concentration. Starting another ends the old before the new effect resolves, except for an explicit limited linked-effect rule. Damage prompts CON save against max(10, floor(damage/2)); incapacitation or a failed save ends concentration. The round-down convention is a deliberate pilot interpretation. Concentration does not demand a Bonus Action unless maintenance says so. For a paid3-pulse effect, start is pulse1; pay maintenance on each of the next2 regular turns by turn end for pulses2/3. Missing payment ends it at that turn's end; otherwise it ends at start of turn4. No repeated start triggers on maintenance.

Forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks unless explicitly stated, cannot place a creature inside solid matter, and stops at an obstacle. Grapples use the card's save/DC, can be escaped with an Action and STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) against that DC, and end beyond reach. A root sets Speed0 but does not remove Actions. Slows reduce Speed to minimum0. Silence blocks verbal spells/audible abilities, not all thought or all class features. Charmed effects never determine a player's beliefs; use only the printed action restrictions.

No repeated hard denial without a new save and cost. For this class suite, a creature can suffer **Stunned, compelled loss of its whole Action/turn, or equivalent hard denial from a given character at most once per encounter**, across that character's class features; later such riders fail while damage and soft riders resolve normally. Record source and target. This draft guard is broader than the older Oracle-only ceiling and is an explicit balance proposal. Reaction denial, Speed reduction, penalties and Frightened do not count as whole-turn loss. Do not silently waive boss immunities, legendary defenses or anatomy.

## Damage, healing, stacking and companions

Roll once for each shared area/pulse and apply saves/defenses to each target separately; separate attacks roll separately. Halve once for a successful save and apply resistance/immunity normally. Same-named conditions/bonuses do not stack unless a printed cap allows it; same-stat flat bonuses from these class techniques use the strongest. Different resources remain separate. Damage reduction from these class features uses the strongest flat reduction, then applies resistance; it cannot create negative damage or healing. Temporary HP never stack; choose the larger remaining amount. Immunity is not reduced resistance.

Repeated permanent HP recovery must consume finite RP, a per-rest use or another finite resource; a combat-generated gauge alone never enables unlimited healing. Healing cannot exceed maximum HP or erase Wounds, death consequences, debt or Corruption unless explicit. Downed is living at0HP; dead is different. Resurrection requires a willing soul and sufficiently intact body, obeys its time window, cannot create a duplicate and never refunds the feature on failure to meet known prerequisites. Sacrificial HP is actual unpreventable loss, cannot be redirected or paid with temporary HP, and is not damage for resource triggers. It cannot reduce the donor below1 unless a card expressly grants a death-triggered effect.

No damage/healing copy repeats the source's costs, procs, resource generation, critical bonus dice, buffs, actions, cooldown resets or duration. Compute fractions once, capped at100% of one stored source unless an explicit card states a separately priced higher amount. Copies still cause ordinary damage consequences, concentration checks and death. A copy cannot copy another copy. A target/source record must refer to an actual resolved event, not merely a known ability name.

Where a class card calls for a **standard companion** without a more specific profile, use: Small or Medium; AC12+floor(PB/2); HP2L; walking Speed30ft; saves equal owner's PB; one melee or ranged attack (reach5ft/range30ft) at owner's class attack bonus, damage S d6 of the printed type. It has no independent class features, resources, loot, death triggers or extra turns. All companions belonging to one character share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging attack/action total per round** unless a specifically priced feature grants more. Without a command they move and Dodge. Act immediately after owner. A standard companion lasts1 minute, disappears at0HP and cannot be healed for free by dismissing/resummoning. The creation cost must be paid again. Creature-specific stat blocks override this profile only where explicitly printed.

## Ordinary spells: one explicit test configuration

Use the manifest-owned **Core Systems Known Descent V2** class RP tables and rank costs: rank0–9 costs0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26; Grand32. Follow `src/data/class-spell-progression.js` for each class's rank gates and the existing spell catalog for class/school access. Having enough RP never bypasses a rank gate. Oracle has Revelation Charges, and Soldier/Warrior have no general RP spellcasting. Multiclass spell access is determined separately per class; do not add complete class pools or use total level to unlock a rank. This suite's printed pool tables are single-class; use the existing multiclass pool formula with the new constituent CoreV2 pools for mixed characters.

Four classes have no direct CoreV2 pool row. For this pilot, Crimson Agent uses the Cleric curve multiplied by0.5; Dragoon, Monk and Thief use that curve multiplied by0.35, rounded to nearest integer with halves upward, minimum1. These fallback factors come from the preserved `src/data/resonance-economy.js`; they are explicitly distinguished from direct book tables. The generic CoreV2 Oracle RP row is rejected for this class suite because Oracle's protected class contract uses Revelation Charges only. Oracle never receives RP or ordinary spell access. Retune here means one recovery at the end of a completed short rest, not an unrestricted action.

For a reproducible pilot, retain the protected **Dissonance** layer with CoreV2 numeric RP costs. This combination is a new integration decision: do not also roll a second historical Burn/fizzle system on top of it. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)). Before a ranked cast, Dissonance at limit/limit+3/limit+6 adds1/2/3RP respectively; at limit+6 ordinary casters cannot cast rank1+. At limit+3 ordinary Overcast is unavailable. A cast then adds base Dissonance0 at rank0,1 at ranks1–5,2 at ranks6–9. Immediate repeated casts of the same named spell add1,2,then3 maximum. Another named spell resets the repeat counter but not accumulated strain. Apply the class's exact cadence reduction/vent; never infer a free RP reduction. Printed class techniques pay printed costs and cause no automatic spell Dissonance unless tagged or expressly described as spells, Echo releases or Matrix casts. For a Mage/Wizard class card tagged as a spell, use the rank printed in normalized data; its rank is fixed at acquisition and does not rise with S. Other techniques are not counterspellable unless their card says so.

Retune recovers max(0,round(maxRP/4)+casting modifier), never above maximum, and clears Dissonance. A long rest restores RP and clears Dissonance. Optional10-minute meditation once/day recovers positive casting modifier RP and reduces Dissonance by PB+positive modifier. A regular turn with no spell or magical class ability loses1 Dissonance; an Action spent Grounding without casting loses PB instead (not both). Merely ending an encounter does not clear accumulated Dissonance. Refrain survives idle/weapon turns unless a class explicitly clears it. Lich/Necromancer may force ranked casts through Fracture; after resolution take direct unpreventable trauma equal to rank×1/2/3 at the three strained states, minimum1, based on state before casting. This trauma cannot generate resources or trigger damage-sharing. They still pay RP and meet rank gates.

Generic Overcast is excluded from the initial suite configuration until its options are separately fixed; cards such as Overchannel have their own exact costs and gates. CoreV2's original Burn procedures, older rank×2 costs and smaller companion RP tables remain preserved as alternatives, not silently combined. This configuration is suitable for comparing class drafts, not a claim that all historical magic sources already agree.

## Spell repertoires and acquisition

Preserve explicit class spellbook/preparation rules where given. For classes missing a known-spell count, this suite proposes: full casters know3 cantrips at1,4 at4,5 at10 and choose2 ranked spells at first spell access plus1 each later class level; hybrid/half/minor casters know2 cantrips at first cantrip access and3 at class10, and choose2 ranked spells at first ranked access plus1 on each later even class level. At a long rest, a known caster may replace one known spell with a legal same-or-lower rank selection. This fills an actual missing rule and does not replace a more specific Druid prepared list or Wizard spellbook. Bonus spells expressly granted by a class are additional. No unnamed or mechanically unfinished catalog spell becomes complete merely by entering this repertoire; select operational spells for the test and record them.

Scheduled selection applies only where the class document says so. At each milestone choose distinct eligible entries; no banked Skill Points. Automatic engines, ASIs, feats, forms and finales do not also consume a choice unless stated. Ordinary-class schedule:4Base at1 (at least2active),2Base at2;2Arch at3 (at least1active); alternating1Base/Arch at4/6/8/11/13/15/17/19 and1Arch at5/7/9; choose Hero at10 and2Hero (at least1active), then1Hero at12/14/16/18; finale20. If a class has no source Arch capstone, level9 has the printed class-specific grant or another choice, explicitly shown. The individual schedule and prerequisite checks win over this summary. ASI or eligible feat at4/8/12/16/19, separate from choices. Druid, Oracle and Paladin use their own schedules.

## Source and review status

The owner asked to extend the Bard treatment to all classes. Each draft separates the original wording, provisional numerical specification, acquisition and examples. Earlier contradictory level-table entries are retained as source evidence and marked reconciled/replaced for this draft; never stack them on top of the new schedule. Automated checks cover acquisition, source completeness and selected resource invariants. Human table play is still needed to judge balance, fun, and numerical tuning.

engine: Blood Gauge (BG) starts and ends each encounter at 0, capacity 3; Spill Control raises capacity 6 while known. Once on your own regular turn, a weapon attack that damages a hostile living creature grants 1 BG. Hemorrhage Slash uses this same trigger, not an additional one. Explicit critical/kill/refund features can add more, but total BG gained is capped 2 per round. Self-inflicted damage, allies, summons, helpless captives and repeated damage to a corpse never generate BG. Blood is an encounter resource, not a currency carried into rest.

Dexterity governs weapon attacks; Intelligence governs hemomancy save DC and M. S scales from Crimson Agent class level. A weapon technique includes only its printed attacks, with normal weapon die plus Dexterity (or Strength when that weapon requires it). No free attack is implied by attack-speed wording. Class BG and RP are separate. Once per turn when casting an ordinary spell, optionally spend 1 BG to prevent 1 of that cast's Dissonance gain, minimum 0; never reduce RP this way.

Your Bleed is a physical ongoing effect on a living, non-bloodless creature: 1d4 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns, then ends. It is not a new attack and generates no BG or procs. Refresh duration instead of stacking; Blood Echo expressly allows two independent instances, maximum. An Action by the victim or an adjacent creature using a healer's kit ends all your Bleeds on that victim. Apply physical resistance/immunity normally. Track remaining ticks and creator per instance. Allied healing versions from Bloodweaver cost RP and never count as hostile Bleeds for detonation, spreading or generation.

One Blood Mark at a time on a living target with your Bleed. Marks last 5 of your regular turns, expire on encounter end or if the target dies, and never create damage by themselves. Rupture requires the target still within 60 ft and line of effect; it spends the mark. A mark does not defeat cover, planar boundaries or bloodlessness. Bloodtrail has its own tracking limits.

Veinweaves are self buffs unless their card expressly allows an ally. They require concentration and one may be active. Crimson Harmony is an explicit exception permitting two Veinweaves as one linked concentration burden; a failed concentration check ends both. A non-Veinweave concentration effect replaces the whole group. BG is spent on activation; no upkeep unless printed. Damage-sharing is redirection before mitigation, not extra damage: apply each recipient's own defenses once and never redirect the redirected portion again.

The healing, execution and denial text below deliberately bounds the source's vague percentage/instant-kill claims. HP sacrificed is direct loss, bypasses temporary HP and defenses, cannot be redirected, and cannot reduce the donor below 1. Only a willing ally can donate. HP sacrifice is never damage for class triggers. No class feature here restores the dead or removes Wounds.

At level 1 learn the core Blood Gauge/Bleed rules automatically. Blood Mark and Veinweaver's Core remain selections; Quickblood can be selected and used without a second unlock tax. Veinweaver's Core improves that foundation as printed. Standard scheduled acquisition applies. Bloodbound Edge is automatic 9. At 10 choose Bloodweaver, Shadow Operative or Thirstborn; its Final Cut is automatic 20. Duplicate Hemostasis names are separate Arch and Bloodweaver IDs.

Capacity clarification: Blood Gauge automatically reaches capacity 6 at class 9. Spill Control allows reaching 6 early but never raises the cap above 6. This new explicit gate ensures a later 5-BG Final Cut can be used without an optional capacity selection. Gain cap 2/round and encounter reset 0 still apply.
classes.protected: Once per turn, spend 1 Blood Gauge while casting to prevent 1 Dissonance; the Agent routes Weave strain through blood rather than gaining free casts.
example: Bard-style example becomes Agent 5: DEX 16, INT 14, S 2, M 2, BG 0/cap 3, full class RP. Select Hemorrhage Slash, Quickblood, Blood Mark, Shroud at 1; Blood Tithe and Vital Targeting at 2; Rupture and Spill Control at 3. Capacity is now 6.
Turn 1: Hemorrhage Slash hits for ordinary weapon damage+2d6, applies Bleed, and gains 1 BG (not 2). Bonus Action Blood Mark pays 1 BG: balance 0. Target takes its first 1d4 Bleed on its next turn.
Turn 2: ordinary weapon attack hits and gains 1 BG. Keep the mark and save resources; Bleed ticks independently and grants no BG.
Turn 3: a second weapon hit gains 1 BG: balance 2. Bonus Action Quickblood spends 1 BG: balance 1. It gives movement, not another attack.

Turn 4: Rupture is an Action, pays 1 BG: balance 0 and consumes the mark. Target fails CON: takes(S+1)d8=3d8. Rupture is not a weapon hit, so it generates no replacement BG. Any remaining Bleed continues.
After the encounter BG becomes 0. Blood Tithe's used short-rest charge and spent RP do not refresh without an actual rest.

cards.name: Arterial Cut
cards.effect: A critical weapon hit applies your Bleed. If it already has your Bleed, extend one instance by 2 ticks, maximum 5 ticks remaining. This damage never generates further BG.

cards.name: Blood Tithe
cards.target: Self after a hostile bleeding creature dies within 30 ft
cards.effect: Regain HP equal to M+class level after a creature bearing your Bleed dies. It must have been an active hostile combatant; no ally, summon, captive or corpse farming.

cards.name: Veinweaver's Core
cards.effect: You can dismiss a Veinweave without an action and switch to another known Veinweave using its normal activation. Once/short rest reduce the BG cost of one Veinweave by 1, minimum 1. The basic one-Veinweave capacity is part of your engine, not locked behind this selection.

cards.name: Vital Targeting
cards.effect: Add S damage to a weapon hit against a target that has not perceived you or is within 5 ft of another conscious hostile-to-it ally. This is flat damage, not a critical die, and requires an actual weapon hit.

cards.name: Shroudstep
cards.effect: After taking the Hide Action and moving at least 10 ft while hidden, gain+1 AC. You still need valid concealment and a successful ordinary Stealth check; this feature does not grant invisibility.

cards.name: Hemorrhage Slash
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon type and apply Bleed. The usual once/turn hit trigger grants 1 BG; this card grants no separate BG.

cards.name: Veinweave: Quickblood
cards.effect: Start a Veinweave: gain+10 ft Speed and ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Once during its duration you may draw or stow one weapon without using your object interaction. It grants no attacks or Actions.

cards.name: Blood Mark
cards.target: One living target with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Apply your Blood Mark. Replaces your previous mark without detonating it. The mark enables Rupture and printed mark interactions; it deals no automatic damage and does not grant vision.

cards.name: Shroud
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack/cast/bright light
cards.effect: Become invisible while in dim light or darkness. Attacking, casting a spell or entering bright light ends it. You must still Hide to conceal your location. Audible movement can reveal your position.

cards.name: Vital Sense
cards.target: Living creatures within 60 ft, excluding total cover
cards.effect: Sense presence and approximate direction, not identity or thoughts. Once during this minute, gain advantage on one weapon attack against a sensed creature you can otherwise legally target. This does not change critical range.

cards.name: Blood Echo
cards.effect: Your Bleed can have two independent instances on a creature; a third application refreshes the oldest. Once on each of your turns add 1 to one Bleed instance's next tick. Never spread or detonate more instances than actually exist.

cards.name: Bio-Alchemical Flow
cards.effect: Activating a self-only Veinweave does not itself end your hidden state or Shroud. Its normal visible effects may reveal you; attacks, spells and other hostile effects still break hiding normally.

cards.name: Spill Control
cards.effect: Blood Gauge capacity rises from 3 to 6. Gain rate is unchanged. This replaces, rather than adds to, the old cap. No BG is granted merely by learning it.

cards.name: Rupture Trigger
cards.target: Up to 2 other enemies within 5 ft of ruptured mark
cards.effect: After Rupture damages its marked target, choose up to 2 other living enemies nearby. Each makes CON save; on failure apply one Bleed. These applications do not trigger Rupture again or grant BG.

cards.name: Crimson Flow
cards.effect: After spending BG, gain+5 ft Speed. Your next weapon damage roll before end next turn adds 1. Repeated expenditures refresh rather than stack; no attack-speed or additional-Action benefit.

cards.name: Crimson Harmony
cards.effect: You may sustain two Veinweaves as one concentration group. Both pay full costs and use normal activations; failing concentration ends both. Identical Veinweaves never stack, and no ordinary concentration spell can join this group.

cards.name: Bloodbound Edge
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: End up to 2 of your Bleed instances per target. Each takes 1d4 per remaining tick, maximum S d4 per creature, ignoring resistance but respecting immunity. This replaces their future ticks and grants no BG, healing or kill-trigger benefit.

cards.name: Veinweave: Bloodshield
cards.effect: Start Bloodshield Veinweave. Gain temporary HP equal to class level+M. Once while they remain, use Reaction to reduce damage to yourself by S. No self-damage refund or BG is generated.

cards.name: Rupture
cards.effect: Target makes CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. The mark ends either way; existing Bleed remains. Damage from this technique is not a weapon hit and grants no BG.

cards.name: Bloodtrail
cards.target: One living target with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: Know the direction to the target while within 1 mile on the same plane. Total distance and a trail are not shown. Lead barriers or effects that block divination block this sense; it grants no attack advantage or targeting through cover.

cards.name: Veinweave: Sensory Theft
cards.target: One living creature with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Target makes WIS save. Failure lets you see and hear through it while it remains within 1 mile on the same plane; you are blind/deaf to your own surroundings. It repeats save at each turn end and whenever it takes damage. No control or thought reading.

cards.name: Hemostasis
cards.effect: End all Bleed on the target and restore S d6+M HP, regardless of number of ticks removed. You cannot create extra healing by inflicting extra Bleed. Works even if no Bleed is present, at the same RP cost.

cards.name: Bloodbond
cards.effect: Create Bloodbond while both remain within 30 ft. When ally takes damage, you may use Reaction to redirect floor(one-quarter of pre-mitigation damage) to yourself; each recipient applies its own defenses once. Once/round when a paid technique heals you, ally gains M temporary HP. No recursive transfers.

cards.name: Hemostasis
cards.target: One willing living ally in range of your Bleed application
cards.effect: You may replace a new Bleed application on that ally with healing 1d4 at start of its next 3 turns. Pay extra RP even if original application was free. One such healing effect per target; it cannot spread, detonate, generate BG or trigger healing loops.

cards.name: Protective Flow
cards.target: Allies actually affected by your Veinweaves
cards.effect: An affected ally gains+1 to saves and reduces each damage instance by 2, minimum 0. This benefit does not stack across Veinweaves or Agents. Self-only Veinweaves cannot be extended merely by this passive.

cards.name: Veinlock Tether
cards.target: Willing linked ally within 30 ft being damaged
cards.effect: While your Bloodbond or Vitality Link is active, redirect up to S+M damage to yourself before mitigation. This is an alternative to Bloodbond's quarter-sharing reaction, not an additional redirection. Redirected damage cannot be redirected again.

cards.name: Crimson Pact
cards.target: Up to 3 bleeding enemies and 6 living allies within 30 ft
cards.effect: End your Bleeds on chosen enemies; each makes CON save against 4d8 necrotic, half on success. Each chosen ally regains 4d8+M HP and gains 10 temporary HP. Use one shared roll per damage/healing effect; healing does not multiply by enemies or remaining ticks.

cards.name: Transfusion
cards.cost: 2 RP; sacrifice up to class level HP
cards.effect: Lose K real HP, at least 1, without falling below 1. Ally regains K+floor(K/2) HP. Loss bypasses defenses and cannot trigger BG, damage-sharing or healing refunds. The RP/use limit remains even if little healing is possible.

cards.name: Veinweave: Vitality Link
cards.effect: Start Vitality Link Veinweave. Once/round when you restore real HP with a paid Agent technique, linked ally regains M HP if within 30 ft. This secondary healing never triggers another link. Gain+1 AC while adjacent to that ally; no spell buffs or resources are copied.

cards.name: Blood Ward
cards.target: Fixed 10 ft radius centered within 30 ft, up to 3 allies
cards.effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or necrotic. Selected allies within the zone gain resistance to that damage type. Leaving loses the benefit; reentering restores it. Identical resistance does not stack. This is not a Veinweave.

cards.name: Purify Blood
cards.effect: End Poisoned and one nonmagical disease. Magical disease needs a successful INT ability check against its stated treatment DC, or DC 15 if absent; failure spends the cost. No curse, Wound, death or Corruption removal.

cards.name: Lifewell
cards.target: Up to 3 living allies within 15 ft
cards.effect: Spend K BG. At start and on each of your next 2 turns, use Bonus Action and pay 1 RP to pulse healing: each chosen ally still within 15 ft regains 1d8+K HP. Without maintenance it ends at turn end. Total 3 pulses; no triggers create more BG.

cards.name: Ghost Vein
cards.effect: A weapon hit made from hidden ignores resistance to that weapon's damage type for this hit. Immunity remains. This does not bypass armor or make the attack automatically hit.

cards.name: Blackout Agent
cards.target: Attacker within 30 ft that missed you
cards.effect: Attacker makes CON save; failure Blinded. Requires it can see you. Each creature becomes immune to your Blackout Agent until encounter end after resolving this save, preventing repeated blind-lock.

cards.name: Ghostflow Reflexes
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once/round after a Veinweave starts, shorten one OTHER positive Agent cooldown by 1; this uses that ability's reset allowance. It grants no critical immunity, actions or per-rest uses.

cards.name: Veinjammer
cards.target: One creature damaged by your Bleed
cards.effect: After a Bleed tick, choose that victim: Speed reduced 5 ft, minimum 0, and its next concentration save takes-1. Nonstacking; does not remove an Action or prohibit spellcasting.

cards.name: Total Silence
cards.effect: Each makes CON save. Failure prevents verbal spellcasting and Reactions, and suppresses one passive bonus to AC or attack rolls chosen from an observed effect. It never removes innate anatomy, immunities, legendary rules or class resource pools. Success prevents all effects; no whole-sheet passive disable.

cards.name: Phantom Strike
cards.target: One enemy in weapon reach; must be hidden from it
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack with advantage. On hit add S d6 damage and apply a mark without its usual BG cost, even if not already bleeding. The mark replaces your old mark; no free Rupture occurs. Normal hit BG gain still capped.

cards.name: Veinweave: Shadow Meld
cards.effect: Start Shadow Meld Veinweave: advantage on Stealth and invisible while motionless in dim light/darkness. Moving removes invisibility until start next turn; attacking or casting ends the Veinweave. No concealment against blindsight or effects that expressly reveal invisibility.

cards.name: Disrupt Flow
cards.effect: CON save: failure prevents Reactions and gives disadvantage on its next spell attack. If concentrating, make an additional normal concentration save versus your class DC. This never disables all special abilities or guarantees a failed concentration check.

cards.name: Blood Cipher
cards.target: One willing or restrained living target with your Bleed touched
cards.effect: Target makes WIS save unless willing. On failure learn one factual sensory memory from the last 24 hours about a stated event; the target chooses a relevant memory if several exist. Success yields no information. No beliefs, absolute truth or unrelated secrets are guaranteed.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.effect: Create magical darkness blocking ordinary sight and darkvision. You can see within it up to 30 ft. Creatures can leave normally; no automatic damage, surprise or advantage when another sense locates you. Enemies still act and make saves normally.

cards.name: Blood Frenzy
cards.effect: Add 1 to direct weapon damage per hostile creature bearing your Bleed, maximum 3. Applies once per hit, not per Bleed instance. Secondary Bleed, copies and explosions gain no bonus.

cards.name: Hemorrhagic Plague
cards.target: One new living enemy within 5 ft of a Bleed victim
cards.effect: After one of your Bleeds ticks, pay 1 BG; new target makes CON save. Failure applies one Bleed. A spread instance cannot spread again. This grants no BG and does not duplicate marks or immediate damage.

cards.name: Pain-to-Power Conduction
cards.target: One enemy within 5 ft after it damages you
cards.effect: End one active Veinweave. Chosen enemy makes CON save: failure takes S d4 necrotic and Bleed; success takes half immediate damage only. On failure by 10 it is Frightened until end next turn. No resource refund.

cards.name: Carrion Conductor
cards.target: One fresh hostile living-combatant corpse within 30 ft
cards.effect: Mark the corpse once; on activation or before expiry use Reaction to burst it. Up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success. Corpse cannot be reused, raised by this effect or provide BG/kill triggers.

cards.name: Veinburst Requiem
cards.target: Up to 6 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: Spend K BG and end your Bleeds on targets. CON save: (S+K)d8 necrotic, half on success. A target failing by 10 with remaining HP no greater than your class level falls to 0; ordinary death rules follow. No percentage-based automatic boss execution or BG refund.

cards.name: Exsanguinate
cards.effect: CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic, half on success; add 1d8 if it has your Bleed. If it fails and actually takes damage, regain 1 BG within the common gain cap. The refund cannot pay activation costs retroactively.

cards.name: Veinweave: Blood Frenzy
cards.effect: Start Blood Frenzy Veinweave: once on your turn add S d6 to one weapon hit; gain+10 ft Speed and suffer-2 AC. No extra attacks, Actions or critical range. Ending early removes both benefit and penalty.

cards.name: Blood Boil
cards.duration: Instant; control until end next turn
cards.effect: CON save: (S+1)d6 fire, half on success. On failure target loses Reactions; on failure by 10 also Stunned until end its next turn. Each creature can be Stunned by this card only once/encounter.

cards.name: Crimson Harvest
cards.target: One enemy in weapon reach at half HP or less
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack; on hit add S d8 damage. If this reduces it to 0, regain S+M HP and 1 BG within gain cap. No instant kill from a percentage threshold; summoned/allied/helpless creatures yield no recovery.

cards.name: Bloodstorm
cards.target: Moving 10 ft aura around self, up to 3 enemies per pulse
cards.effect: On start and each later paid pulse, targets make CON saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success; failure applies one Bleed. Maintenance costs Bonus Action+1 RP. Maximum 3 pulses. Once/turn your direct weapon attack against a creature in the storm adds 1 damage; storm/bleed damage gives no BG.

engine: Strength is the class ability. Momentum starts/ends encounters at 0; cap 5, rising to 7 with Momentum Overflow or automatically at class 9. On each regular turn, moving at least 15 ft under your own power grants 1 Momentum, and damaging an enemy with a weapon attack grants 1 more. These are the only default gains; all gains/refunds together cap 2 per round. Forced movement, teleportation, movement in place, allies and summons cannot farm Momentum. Movement counts actual path traveled toward a tactical destination; one threshold per turn.

A leap technique moves you through an unobstructed arc to a visible unoccupied landing space within its range, adjacent to its target when attacking. Land during the same activation. It spends movement equal to horizontal distance, unless the card expressly supplies additional movement. A leap never gives flight, indefinite airborne immunity or free attacks. You cannot leap through ceilings/walls; vertical height is at most half the printed horizontal range. Safe technique landings do not cause self-fall damage; interrupted/falling travel follows ordinary falling rules. No bonus damage is earned by repeatedly dropping from a ledge.

All attack cards use a wielded polearm unless they explicitly describe a non-weapon save effect. A technique is its own Action, not an Attack Action plus free technique. At class 5 your ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks, at most two even when multiclass features overlap; each technique still gives only printed attacks. This automatic Extra Attack is a new explicit advancement specification for the pilot.

Armor bypass means the exact printed attack bonus or resistance exception, never subtracting a percentage of the target's whole AC. Critical ranges do not stack. A Dragoon can use only one free/Bonus Action leap granted by class features per round; it cannot trigger another free leap. Extra full Actions share the suite-wide cap. Reaction intercepts require a legal path and destination and do not rewind resolved damage.

Spending Momentum pays before resolution; a hit refund cannot pay its own activation. Burn means 1d4 fire at start of target's next 2 turns, nonstacking. Bleed means 1d4 physical at start of next 2 turns; an Action with a healer's kit ends it. Do Ts give no Momentum or critical triggers. Hard denial uses the shared once-per-target/encounter guard.

When casting an ordinary spell after moving at least 20 ft this turn, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by 1, minimum 0; no automatic RP discount. Dragoon techniques are martial unless their card specifies elemental magic. Use Core V 2 RP and the Dragoon rank gates for separate spellcasting.

Use scheduled Base/Arch/Hero choices. Skybound Assault, Momentum Engine and related passives improve the automatic engine rather than unlock basic movement or generation. Lancer's Apex is automatic 9; at 10 choose Dragon Guardian, Drake Rider or Dragon Tyrant. The corresponding Final Flight is automatic 20. Apex Assault is an active technique despite its source passive heading.
classes.protected: If the Dragoon moved at least 20 feet before a Weave cast, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0); Momentum carries the note through motion.
example: Dragoon 5, STR 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3; start Momentum 0. Know Dragon Leap, Momentum Surge, Wyvern's Guard and Draconic Roar at 1; Momentum Engine and Draconic Discipline at 2; Dragonflight and Momentum Overflow at 3. Capacity 7.
Turn 1: Dragon Leap spends 0 Momentum and moves 20 ft of Speed 30. Weapon attack hits: movement+hit each gain 1, ending 2. It rolls weapon damage+2d6. Land immediately.

Turn 2: Bonus Action Momentum Surge spends 2, balance 0, increases movement. Move 20 ft and use ordinary Attack Action: first successful hit and movement return 2 total, even if both attacks hit. End 2.
Turn 3: Dragonflight costs 2, balance 0. It supplies movement up to 60 ft as part of the Action; hit and movement regain 2 within the common cap. End 2; no additional normal Attack Action.
Turn 4: if knocked prone, use Aerial Recovery only if known and your Reaction is available. Its 1 Momentum still counts toward the round gain cap. A second refund cannot exceed 2 total gains.
End encounter: Momentum 0. RP, per-rest uses and other party resources do not refill.

cards.name: Skybound Assault
cards.target: One target hit by your leap
cards.effect: After a leap moves at least 15 ft and its attack hits, add S damage. Its hit grants ordinary Momentum, not an extra point. This benefit cannot trigger from forced movement or a leap granted by this same feature.

cards.name: Draconic Discipline
cards.effect: Gain advantage on saves against being knocked Prone or forcibly moved. It does not protect against Stunned, spell damage or grappling unless the save also imposes one of those named effects.

cards.name: Momentum Engine
cards.effect: After your first 15 ft of voluntary movement generates Momentum, ignore the next 5 ft of nonmagical difficult terrain this turn. The movement threshold itself is automatic class engine; this feature does not create another gain trigger.

cards.name: Dragoon's Reach
cards.effect: Increase your wielded polearm's reach by 5 ft, maximum 15 ft. Once/own turn a natural 19 polearm attack that hits critically hits. It does not extend the range of other abilities or stack with another critical-range expansion.

cards.name: Aerial Poise
cards.effect: When a ranged attack hits you during your leap movement, halve its damage. You must spend the Reaction before damage resolves. Remaining airborne between turns cannot be declared to keep this protection active.

cards.name: Dragon Leap
cards.target: One polearm enemy at landing point within 30 ft
cards.effect: Leap, spending normal movement, then make one polearm attack. On hit add S d6 weapon-type damage. Legal movement and a hit may each grant 1 Momentum under the common cap. Land immediately; height never adds unbounded damage.

cards.name: Piercing Thrust
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack with+2 to the attack roll. On hit add S d4 weapon damage. This is the complete armor-piercing benefit; no percentage of AC is removed and critical range is unchanged.

cards.name: Wyvern's Guard
cards.effect: The next attack that damages you has damage reduced by S d6+M, minimum 0; then the guard ends. Roll the reduction only when damage occurs. This reduction cannot heal or reflect damage.

cards.name: Momentum Surge
cards.effect: Gain+15 ft Speed and+1 on your next polearm attack this turn. Spend before moving; movement may then generate normal Momentum. Grants no attack, extra Action, Bonus Action or Reaction.

cards.name: Draconic Roar
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies and 3 allies within 15 ft that hear you
cards.effect: Enemies make WIS saves; failure Frightened of you. Chosen allies gain advantage on their next save against Frightened before duration ends. A creature may repeat the WIS save at its turn end, ending fear on success.

cards.name: Crater Strike
cards.target: Up to 2 enemies within 5 ft of your leap landing
cards.effect: After your leap attack hits, optionally pay 1; each selected adjacent enemy makes STR save or falls Prone. No additional weapon damage or Momentum gain. Landing on an occupied space is not permitted.

cards.name: Momentum Overflow
cards.effect: Momentum cap becomes 7 early; cap becomes 7 for all Dragoons at 9. When starting a weapon technique with 6 or 7 Momentum, its first hit adds 1d6 damage before costs are deducted. Once/own turn, not per point above 5; no stored overflow beyond 7.

cards.name: Piercing Howl
cards.effect: Your next polearm attack gains+2 to hit and ignores resistance to its weapon damage type. Immunity remains. It does not ignore shields, natural armor, cover or arbitrary halves of AC.

cards.name: Lance Tempo
cards.effect: After moving 15 ft voluntarily, gain+1 AC. If you critically hit with a polearm that turn, add 1d6 weapon damage once. The added die does not double itself or create further critical triggers.

cards.name: Wyvern's Flow
cards.target: Self after a damaging leap hit
cards.effect: Regain 1 Momentum within the total 2-per-round gain cap, and shorten one OTHER positive leap cooldown by 1. Shortening uses that ability's reset allowance. No free leap or Action follows.

cards.name: Apex Assault
cards.target: One enemy in polearm reach after leap up to 30 ft
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum and leap using normal movement. Make one polearm attack; on hit add min(K, 5)d6 weapon damage. On a miss no bonus damage; expenditure remains. Gains from this activation cannot exceed the common cap.

cards.name: Lancer's Apex
cards.cost: All Momentum at current maximum; 1 short-rest use
cards.effect: Before paying the leap's Momentum cost, spend all maximum Momentum instead and use that leap as a Bonus Action, still paying other costs. It cannot trigger another free leap. Damage and hit generation use ordinary caps; this grants no extra Bonus Action.

cards.name: Dragonflight
cards.target: One enemy adjacent to landing within 60 ft
cards.effect: Leap up to 60 ft as additional movement supplied by this Action. Make one polearm attack on landing; on hit add(S+1)d6 weapon damage. No damage scaling from distance/height and no remaining flight.

cards.name: Spear Cyclone
cards.target: Up to 3 distinct enemies in polearm reach
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack against each. No target is attacked twice. Hit-based Momentum can be gained only once this turn regardless of number of hits; movement and refund caps still apply.

cards.name: Momentum Burst
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum. Next polearm hit this turn adds min(K, 4)d6 weapon damage. If the next attack misses the effect ends. It does not widen critical range or multiply another added damage package.

cards.name: Aerial Recovery
cards.target: Self just knocked Prone or pushed
cards.effect: After the triggering displacement resolves, stand from Prone without movement cost and move 5 ft to an unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks. Gain 1 Momentum within the round cap. Cannot prevent falling without a legal landing.

cards.name: Dragon's Eye
cards.effect: Study it: your first polearm attack against it has advantage, and you learn one of its visible damage resistances if any. No automatic critical, secret full stat block or ability to attack through cover.

cards.name: Aegis Leap
cards.target: Ally within 15 ft targeted by an attack
cards.effect: Before the attack roll, leap to an empty space adjacent to ally using this supplied movement. Become the target if the attack can reach you; resolve against your AC. Cannot be used if restrained or no path. Counts as your one intercept reaction.

cards.name: Wyrmhide
cards.target: Self while above half maximum HP
cards.effect: Reduce each damage instance by 2 and gain advantage on CON saves against Bleed, Burn and Poisoned. No blanket condition immunity; effects already present persist and ordinary nonstacking reduction applies.

cards.name: Momentum Shield
cards.effect: After spending at least 1 Momentum, gain temporary HP equal to amount spent+M, maximum 10. Later expenditure replaces with the higher remaining value; no real HP restoration.

cards.name: Spiral Defense
cards.target: Melee attacker in polearm reach that misses you while at maximum Momentum
cards.effect: Make one polearm attack. Pay Momentum after checking the maximum prerequisite. This counter grants no Momentum and cannot trigger another counter or leap. It consumes your ordinary Reaction.

cards.name: Bastion Descent
cards.target: Leap within 30 ft; up to 6 allies within 15 ft of landing
cards.duration: Instant; protection until start next turn
cards.effect: Land in empty space. Chosen allies gain 4d8+M temporary HP and may end Frightened or Poisoned. They gain resistance to the next damage instance before your next turn. No healing, resurrection or removal of Wounds.

cards.name: Guardian's Intercept
cards.target: Ally within 30 ft being hit by an attack
cards.effect: Leap adjacent before damage, becoming the target of that already successful hit; halve damage to you after normal mitigation. No new roll against your AC. Requires legal path/landing. You cannot also use Aegis Leap on the same attack.

cards.name: Draconic Ward
cards.target: Self and up to 3 allies within 10 ft
cards.effect: Project a ward: chosen creatures while within 10 ft reduce damage by S, minimum 0. The reduction does not stack with Wyrmhide or another flat class reduction. No passive healing or extra Actions.

cards.name: Wyrmscale Defense
cards.effect: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing and advantage on saves against Poisoned, Frightened and Stunned. This is not immunity; existing conditions still require their ordinary removal.

cards.name: Momentum Barrier
cards.effect: Spend K Momentum. Each gains K+S d6 temporary HP, using one shared dice roll. These HP do not stack with other shields and no unspent Momentum remains. This is not concentration.

cards.name: Dragon's Sanctuary
cards.target: Fixed 15 ft-radius zone centered within 30 ft; up to 6 allies
cards.effect: Chosen allies inside reduce damage by 5 and have advantage against Frightened/Charmed. On start and each of your next 2 turns, Bonus Action lets one ally inside repeat one save against a present Frightened, Charmed or Poisoned effect. No automatic mass cleanse each turn.

cards.name: Drake Mark
cards.target: One creature hit by your leap
cards.effect: Mark that creature; your first subsequent direct polearm hit adds S damage. A new mark replaces old. No extra damage to the triggering leap, Do Ts or copies; it is not a spell mark.

cards.name: Elemental Spearcraft
cards.effect: Choose fire, cold or lightning. Once/own turn one polearm hit adds 1d6 chosen damage. Switching requires a new activation and full cost. Does not stack with Elemental Lance's bonus; use stronger.

cards.name: Air Mastery
cards.effect: Increase leap range by 10 ft, not vertical ceiling penetration or flight. After a successful leap hit, shorten one OTHER positive leap cooldown by 1 using its reset allowance. Does not combine with Wyvern's Flow on the same counter in a round.

cards.name: Momentum Tempo
cards.target: Self after spending at least 3 Momentum on a technique this turn
cards.effect: Pay 3 additional Momentum now to gain one extra full Action on your next turn. Shared cap applies; it cannot grant another Action or another Momentum Tempo. Triggering technique must have been paid without this additional cost. No queued actions.

cards.name: Drakestorm Dive
cards.target: Leap up to 60 ft; up to 6 enemies within 15 ft of landing
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. DEX save:6d8 chosen damage, half on success. On failure fire applies Burn, cold reduces Speed 10 ft until end next turn, lightning prevents Reactions until then. Land in legal empty space; no additional weapon attack.

cards.name: Elemental Lance
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. Once/own turn a hit adds S d4 damage; fire adds 1 damage, cold reduces target Speed 5 ft until end next turn, lightning denies opportunity attacks until start its next turn. Nonstacking with Spearcraft; one element rider/turn.

cards.name: Drake's Agility
cards.effect: Gain+20 ft Speed and may replace 10 ft of normal movement with a leap of 10 ft horizontally/5 ft vertically. This is movement only, not another leap attack or technique. No new Action or attack is granted.

cards.name: Aerial Combo
cards.target: Up to 2 enemies adjacent to legal landings within 30 ft
cards.effect: Leap to first target, attack once, then leap up to 15 ft to second and attack once. All movement supplied by Action; two attacks maximum even with Extra Attack. Add 1d6 to each hit. Only one hit-generated Momentum per turn.

cards.name: Elemental Adaptation
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning: gain resistance to that type and may convert normal polearm weapon damage to it. This adds no damage and cannot combine with another resistance multiplicatively. Choice fixed for duration.

cards.name: Drakestorm
cards.target: Moving 10 ft aura; up to 3 enemies per pulse
cards.effect: Choose element. Start and on each of next 2 turns, Bonus Action pulses S d6 damage, DEX half. During duration Speed+10 ft. No free weapon attacks or Momentum from pulse damage; maximum 3 pulses.

cards.name: Tyrant's Crash
cards.target: Up to 2 enemies within 5 ft of your leap landing
cards.effect: After a leap hit pay 1. Targets make WIS save; on failure Frightened and-1 AC. Save repeated at each turn end ends both. This neither stacks AC penalties nor affects enemies beyond the printed area.

cards.name: Momentum Feeder
cards.target: Self on polearm critical or hostile kill
cards.effect: Gain 2 Momentum, still within total 2-per-round gain cap. A critical kill is one trigger, not two. Do Ts, copies, allies, summons and helpless creatures cannot trigger it.

cards.name: Wyrmblood Surge
cards.effect: After spending Momentum, your next direct polearm hit adds damage equal to points spent, maximum 5. Further spending replaces rather than adds this bonus. It is flat damage and grants no resource refund.

cards.name: Skypiercer Stance
cards.effect: Increase leap vertical clearance allowance by 10 ft, never through solid obstacles. Once/own turn a natural 19 polearm hit critically hits; use the broadest critical range rather than stacking. It does not let you remain flying.

cards.name: Sovereign Descent
cards.target: Leap up to 60 ft; up to 6 enemies within 15 ft
cards.effect: STR save:6d8 bludgeoning, half on success. Failure knocks Prone and applies one Bleed and Burn. Failure by 10 also Stuns until end target's next turn, subject to denial cap. Ground becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute; no destruction of structural supports.

cards.name: Tyrant's Impale
cards.duration: Instant; pin until end next turn
cards.effect: Weapon attack; hit adds S d6 piercing. A hit creature no more than one size larger makes STR save or is Restrained and Bleeding. It may use Action STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) versus class DC to end restraint. You must stay in reach to maintain pin.

cards.name: Draconic Dominance
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: WIS save or Frightened; each repeats save at its turn end. On failure by 10 it must use up to 10 ft of its next normal movement away from you by a safe route, not a full Action or hazardous compulsory movement.

cards.name: Momentum Rampage
cards.effect: Once/own turn your first polearm hit adds S d6 damage. Gain+10 ft Speed but suffer-1 AC. No extra attacks, Actions, crit range or scaling from an unbounded resource count.

cards.name: Terrain Shatter
cards.target: Up to 4 enemies in 10 ft radius centered within polearm reach
cards.effect: STR save: (S+1)d6 bludgeoning, half on success; failure Prone. Ground becomes difficult terrain, excluding reinforced structures and magical floors. This creates neither a pit nor free falling damage.

cards.name: Wyrmking's Wrath
cards.effect: Your first leap technique each turn costs 1 less Momentum, minimum 1, and its first hit adds 1d8 damage. Once during duration convert one non-Finale Action leap to Bonus Action, paying costs; consumes your one free/Bonus Action leap allowance and grants no extra Action.

engine: Wisdom governs spells, form attacks and class DC/M. Hit Die d8; book armor, weapons, saves and skills remain. Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.

This class follows its explicit book progression instead of the ordinary 25-choice template. Base 1 grants Druidic, spellcasting, all five Base forms and 2 shifts/long rest. Choose one of seven Circles at 2; its level 2 features are a Base-stage exception. Enter the chosen Circle Arch path at 3, gain its 6 feature, then Circle Hero forms at 10 and its 14 feature. Arch Forms unlock 11 despite the historical word Arch; these are forms, not a second promotion. At 11 attune up to 2 Arch forms during long rest. Base forms remain available at higher levels. All features below are automatic at their gate for the chosen Circle; no generic extra class-card choices are added.

Preparation: two cantrips at 1, three at 4, four at 10, plus explicit Circle bonuses. Prepare class level+WIS modifier ranked Druid spells (minimum 1) each long rest, rank limited by Druid spell-rank access, not merely by enough RP. Use approved operational spell entries and Core V 2 RP table/costs in the shared configuration. Book rank-times-two cost and imported spell-slot terminology are preserved as superseded alternatives for this pilot. Circle always-prepared spells do not count toward preparation and use ordinary RP/Dissonance. Rituals must have ritual tag, be prepared and take printed casting time plus 10 minutes; waive base RP only, never consumed materials or other costs. ASI/feat milestones 4/8/12/16/19 belong to general advancement and must not be granted twice.

Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

Circle of the Land chooses one terrain at 2. Always-prepared spell pairs at 3/5/7/9 are exactly the source table lines 2662–2669, reproduced in source appendix; their source names resolve to existing approved spell entries before use. They do not bypass rank gates. For this pilot Circle spells are permitted exceptions to ordinary list membership, not newly authored variants. Moon Circle Forms CR table is historical external-stat language: use only these bounded forms, not arbitrary CR beasts. Early Moon benefit is +S damage on first form hit each turn. No imported monster multiattack, spellcasting or legendary actions.

Circle summary: Land preserves lore and recovery; Moon improves shifting; Storm controls lightning and wind; Thorns works poison and roots; Winterfang works cold; Rotshaper uses bounded swarms; Ashen Grove works fire and regrowth. Land/Thorns duplicate Blight Elk and Tanglemaw names are kept as separate source identities. Source auto-failed hostile saves in Master of Decay/Ash become once/turn-2 on one save, not unavoidable control. Stronger supplemental flavor riders are represented explicitly below or retained as unadopted alternatives in source provenance.
classes.protected: Entering Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter because the Druid changes the body sounding the Weave; beast-form casting remains limited by class features.
example: Druid 5 Moon, WIS 16 PB 3 S 2 M 3: RP 12, shifts 3, Buffer Reserve 13, Form Surges 3, HP 30/38. Prepare 8 ranked spells plus three cantrips.

Turn 1 Bonus Action Bear: shifts 3→2, draw 13 of requested 20 buffer, reserve 13→0, temp HP 13. Action claw attack PB+WIS=+6, damage 2d6+3+1 plus Moon first-hit 2. Shifting clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name; accumulated Dissonance is unchanged.
Enemy deals 10 damage: temp HP 13→3, real HP 30 remains. No additional beast HP exists.
Turn 2 Moon healing Bonus Action spends 2 RP, RP 12→10, rolls 2d8=7, HP 30→37. It cannot repair the buffer reserve. Action claw as usual.
Turn 3 Bonus Action change Wolf spends another shift, shifts 2→1. Old Bear temporary HP ends. Wolf bite 1d8+3, target STR against DC 14 or Prone. No new buffer, RP or Form Surge generated.
At 10 this character gains Moon Hero forms; Arch forms still wait until 11. At 20 unlimited changes still cannot refill Buffer or Surge reserves.

cards.name: Druidic
cards.effect: Know Druidic. Other speakers notice and read your hidden Druidic messages. Nonspeakers notice their presence on WIS Perception DC 15 but need translation magic or learning the language to read them.

cards.name: Spellcasting
cards.effect: Prepare and cast according to the engine. WIS attack/DC; rank gates, components, concentration, Dissonance and RP apply. This entry creates no extra actions or second resource pool.

cards.name: Shapeshifting
cards.effect: Assume an unlocked prepared form or revert early. Apply engine HP, equipment, concentration and reserve rules. This is not a spell and cannot copy monster stat blocks.

cards.name: Wolf Form (Striker)
cards.effect: Speed 40 ft; advantage on hearing/smell Perception. Bite 1d8 piercing+WIS; target STR save against Druid DC or Prone, once/target/round. All damage remains your own HP.

cards.name: Bear Form (Tank)
cards.cost: One shift; buffer drawn from reserve
cards.effect: Gain up to 20 temporary HP from reserve; AC max(normal, 14). Claw 2d6 slashing+WIS+1. Buffer disappears on reversion and cannot be refilled through free shifting.

cards.name: Hawk Form (Scout)
cards.effect: Tiny, flight 60 ft, walking 10 ft, advantage on sight Perception. Talon 1d4 slashing+WIS; advantage if you descended at least 10 ft immediately before attack. No carrying Medium allies or casting spells before 18.

cards.name: Boar Form (Brawler)
cards.effect: Resistance to slashing. Tusk 1d6 piercing+WIS. After moving 10 ft directly toward target, first hit/turn adds 1d6 and STR save or push 5 ft; no repeated charges from forced movement.

cards.name: Panther Form (Stealth)
cards.effect: Speed 40 ft, darkvision 60 ft, +4 Stealth. Claw 2d4 slashing+WIS; after 20 ft straight approach hit, STR save or Grappled. Escape Action against Druid DC; ends on separation/reversion. Only one held target, no free Restrained.

cards.name: Timeless Body
cards.effect: Age one year per ten elapsed years. Does not prevent damage, aging magic, hunger, disease or rest requirements, and grants no retroactive lifespan restoration.

cards.name: Beast Spells
cards.effect: Perform verbal/somatic Druid spell components in any form. Still cannot supply material components from melded gear. At 20 Archdruid waives only noncostly unconsumed components.

cards.name: Archdruid
cards.effect: Unlimited legal form changes. Buffer Reserve and Form Surges remain finite; per-rest powers, spell costs and uses never refresh on changing form. Ignore verbal/somatic and noncostly unconsumed material components for Druid spells, including in form.

cards.name: Dire Wolf
cards.duration: Form 10 minutes; fear up to 3 rounds
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Speed 40 ft, bite 2d6 piercing+WIS; advantage when active ally threatens target 5 ft. Howl Action up to 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened, repeat end each turn, maximum 3 rounds. No free bite with Howl.

cards.name: Earth Warden (Dire Bear)
cards.target: Self; 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Gain up to 30 temp HP from reserve, nonmagical physical resistance. Slam DEX save 2d6 bludgeoning+WIS and Prone on failure, half damage no Prone success. Ordinary claw 1d8+WIS when Slam unavailable.

cards.name: Sky Serpent
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Flight 80 ft with hover, +2 DEX saves. Bite 2d8 lightning+WIS. Once/shift may spend 1 Form Surge to add 1d4 against wet target; no repeated electrical propagation.

cards.name: Ironhorn Ram
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. AC max(normal, 17), immune Prone. Ram 1d8+WIS bludgeoning; after 20 ft straight approach first hit/turn adds 3d6, STR against Druid DC or push 10 ft. No bonus against same target more than once/round.

cards.name: Shadow Lynx
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Claw 2d4+WIS magical slashing; +2 Stealth while motionless. When attack would hit, Reaction teleport 30 ft to visible empty space, causing triggering attack to miss if you leave its reach/range. Next claw before end next turn advantage. No blanket immunity to magical damage.

cards.name: Bonus Cantrip
cards.effect: Learn one additional Druid cantrip. Choose one terrain package for Circle Spells at 3/5/7/9; preserve exact source spell pairs and ordinary rank gates.

cards.name: Natural Recovery
cards.effect: Restore ceil(Druid level/2)RP, capped by maximum. This is a finite added recovery, not spell slots or multiplied by rank. RP remains fungible; preserved source rank 6 spending restriction is not used in this simplified draft.

cards.name: Land's Stride
cards.effect: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and ordinary plant thorns. Advantage on saves against magically created/manipulated plants impeding movement. Does not bypass walls, fire or nonplant restraint.

cards.name: Nature's Ward
cards.effect: Immune to Charmed/Frightened from fey/elementals, poison damage, Poisoned and disease. Does not suppress all creature abilities or remove an existing curse.

cards.name: Blight Elk
cards.effect: Antlers 2d8+WIS piercing. Enemy starting within 5 ft CON save or 1d4 poison. Wither unattended mundane vegetation within 5 ft cosmetically; tainted water is visibly foul and harmless after 10 minutes. No mass contamination or permanent resource fabrication.

engine: Intelligence is the class ability; use d8 Hit Die from the detailed book, recording the older runtime d6 as superseded for this draft. You begin with 3 empty Echo Slots. Expansion II raises ordinary capacity 5; Sacred/Floating memory features may add one restricted slot, but total concurrent stored Echoes never exceeds 6. Slots are storage, not spell slots. Releasing normally empties that record. Rest restores RP, not spent Echoes. Starting a new encounter does not duplicate the archive.

Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.

Standard acquisition applies; baseline Mirrorbind, Echo Release and summon procedure become usable by selecting their cards. Echo Channeling and Mirrorcall are upgrades, not duplicate mandatory unlocks. The contradiction between source initial 3 slots and Expansion I 2→3 is reconciled as an archive-safety upgrade below. Perfect Reflection automatic 9, Hero choice 10, corresponding Final 20. The finale does not override copy eligibility or the shared release cap.
classes.protected: The first replay of a newly Mirrorbound Echo ignores Refrain Dissonance; repeating the same stored Echo builds Refrain normally.
example: Mirrorsage 5, INT 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3, RP 9, three slots; know Mirrorbind, Echo Release, Mirror Beast Summon, Reflective Shield at 1, Beast Instinct and Reflective Pulse at 2; Mimicry Focus and Reflective Analysis at 3. Begin with Focus 1.
Turn 1: witness an eligible serpent's rank 1 poison cone, then Mirrorbind on your turn. It fails WIS save; store Burst/poison/rank 1. RP stays 9; one encounter capture spent.

Turn 2: Echo Release is Action and 2 RP, RP 9→7; empty the stored slot. Up to 3 enemies roll DEX against 14 for 2d6 poison, half on success. First release ignores Refrain but still adds 1 base Dissonance.
Turn 3: without another stored Echo you cannot simply release again. Use a weapon or ordinary legal spell. A short rest restores RP but not the consumed record.

Alternative turn 2: summon Mirror Beast for 2 RP, leaving RP 7 and the Echo stored. On turn 3 use Action Echo Release plus Bonus Action command to originate it from the Beast, pay 2 RP, ending 5; the Beast cannot also attack that round.
A failed Mirrorbind capture still expends its encounter attempt. Beast Instinct's limited retry may help if known; a boss excluded by eligibility cannot be made eligible with a high roll.

cards.effect: On entry activation and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action maintenance, selected enemies make WIS save; failure gives disadvantage on next attack before your next turn. Inside, your Mirrorbind range extends 30 ft. No additional capture attempts/releases or pocket escape route.
