engine: Dexterity governs weapons; Wisdom governs primal technique DC/M. This draft uses the detailed book's d8 Hit Die; older runtime d10 remains preserved as a conflicting alternative. At 1 gain Track Target engine: Bonus Action mark one perceived enemy within 90 ft for 1 minute, no RP, one quarry at a time; new mark replaces old. Once/own turn a weapon hit against quarry adds S damage. Mark does not reveal creatures through total cover. Track Target selection is an upgrade, not a second unlock tax.

Weapon Synergy tracks last successful direct weapon hit on your own turns. Changing melee→ranged grants+1 to that ranged attack roll if it is your first attack of the turn; changing ranged→melee makes the hit apply Bleed 1d4 on target's next 2 turns. Once/turn synergy; Do Ts, copies, companions, forced attacks and misses do not advance it. At 5 ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks; techniques use only printed counts. You may draw/stow one weapon as normal object interaction; Dual Style later improves this.

Elemental Attunement is defensive; Elemental Imbue is the separate Pathfinder feature gated 6. Imbue Bonus Action 2 RP, one element for 3 of your turns; once/turn a weapon hit adds 1d4 of chosen element plus fire:Burn 1d4 next target turn, cold:Speed-10 ft until end next turn, poison:CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn. Nonstacking; Do Ts never build Hit Chain. Switching element pays again.

Druidic Arrow Combo starts at Ranger 11, not at Base 1. Each direct successful weapon hit adds 1 Hit Chain, maximum 2 gained per regular turn and cap 3. Completing 3 primes one Arrow until end next turn; using it consumes the chain, even on miss. Efficient Killer lowers threshold 2. Chain starts/ends encounters 0, cannot be stocked against allies/captives/summons and is cleared by incapacitation. The Arrow is one Action with a ranged weapon attack or the stated save, costs 0 RP when primed, and is a magical class technique rather than an ordinary spell cast. At most one Arrow per round; it cannot advance its own chain. It requires a wielded bow and ammunition. Ordinary attack/damage riders apply once as printed, never another free arrow.

All Rangers learn five bounded Arrows at 11. Emberroot requires the previous 3 successful weapon hits carried fire imbue: ranged attack, weapon+S d6 fire on hit; up to 2 others within 5 ft take S fire, and primary target Burns 1d4 next turn. Glacial Thorn requires 2 ranged+1 melee among those 3 hits: ranged attack weapon+S d6 cold; on hit STR save or Speed 0 until end next turn. Venomlash requires poisoned/blighted terrain at you or target: ranged attack weapon+S d6 poison; on hit CON save or-1 damage on its next attack. Spirit Fang requires quarry: ranged attack at advantage, weapon+S d6 force; ignores resistance but not immunity on the added force only. Cleansing Grove requires natural terrain at you or target: up to 3 living allies within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft each end Frightened or Poisoned; no attack or damage.

Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

A successful direct weapon hit between ordinary spell casts clears Refrain and gives the next ordinary spell before end next turn 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. The benefit is single-use/nonstacking; it reduces neither RP nor both base and repeat separately. Ordinary spells use Ranger rank gates and the shared test magic configuration.

Base choices 1–2, Pathfinder Arch 3–9, and chosen Warder/Stalker/Outrider Hero 10–20 are distinct stages. No source Arch capstone/Finale exists: level 9 receives its normal eligible choice, while 20 automatically improves your Hero Arrow once/long rest (new capstone below). Do not acquire a Hero by spending Base choices. Beast Companion is one permanent bond; it must be a willing/tamed noncorrupted beast with INT<7 and CR no greater than your class level. Its combat profile uses the bounded companion below rather than importing a full CR 20 monster.
classes.protected: A successful weapon hit between spell casts clears Refrain and reduces the next spell's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0), rewarding the Ranger's martial/primal cadence.
example: Ranger 11, DEX 18, WIS 16, PB 4, S 3, M 3, RP 18. Track quarry with Bonus Action; no RP spent. Start Hit Chain 0.
Turn 1 normal Attack Action has 2 attacks; both hit quarry, chain 0→2. Apply quarry bonus 3 once, not twice. No Arrow until next qualifying hit.

Turn 2 first weapon attack hits, chain 2→3 and primes Arrow. You already spent your Action on Attack, so cannot freely add an Arrow. An extra Action from an ally would use the shared cap, but none is assumed.
Turn 3 use Spirit Fang Arrow as Action, consume chain 3→0, pay 0 RP. On hit weapon+3d6 force; advantage does not double damage. The Arrow cannot rebuild its own chain.

Turn 4 cast an ordinary rank 1 spell after the previous direct weapon hit between casts. Pay 2 RP, RP 18→16 plus any pre-existing strain surcharge. Its base 1 D is reduced by 1 to 0; the one-use cadence benefit ends.
On encounter end unused chain and mark expire. RP does not refill. Natural-terrain healing and companions still need their printed finite costs.

cards.name: Weapon Bond
cards.target: One bow or pair of blades touched
cards.effect: Bond weapons. Bonus Action summons one bonded weapon to your hand from within 30 ft if not held by another creature and no total cover. Cannot disarm someone or cross planar boundaries; bond no additional items.

cards.name: Track Target
cards.effect: You have advantage on Survival checks to follow its physical tracks for 1 hour after the mark ends. While it is marked, once/turn your first hit also ignores 2 points of nonmagical flat damage reduction. Does not pierce immunity or reveal through cover.

cards.name: Natural Explorer
cards.effect: Advantage on Survival checks in natural terrain; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain caused by vegetation, loose earth, mud or snow. Magical terrain, climbing and hazards still require their own rules.

cards.name: Keen Senses
cards.effect: Gain+2 Perception and passive Perception. You still need a sense that can detect the target; this does not reveal invisible creatures automatically or read tracks through solid stone.

cards.name: Combat Focus
cards.effect: Choose one: Precision adds 1 to first ranged attack each turn against quarry; Momentum gives+5 ft Speed after switching weapon mode; Wild Hunt gives advantage on Survival to follow injured creatures and+1 initiative. Choices do not stack; no general retraining.

cards.name: Quick Shot
cards.effect: Make one ranged weapon attack, dealing weapon die only without ability damage modifier. Does not trigger Extra Attack or another Quick Shot; may gain one Hit Chain point at 11 within the turn cap.

cards.name: Twin Strike
cards.target: One or 2 enemies in melee reach; two light weapons wielded
cards.effect: Make one attack with each weapon. Add ability modifier to first hit only. These are the full attacks for this Action; do not add ordinary Extra Attack. Hit Chain gains at 11 cap 2 per turn.

cards.name: Nature's Whisper
cards.effect: Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

cards.name: Skirmisher's Step
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Supplied movement does not increase remaining normal movement. Requires an unblocked route; no teleport or escape from restraints.

cards.name: Elemental Attunement
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/poison. Gain resistance to that damage and sense an exposed source of it within 15 ft. Does not infuse weapons, detect through total cover or identify exact poison recipes.

cards.name: Ignore Difficult Terrain
cards.effect: Ignore movement cost increases from difficult terrain, including magical terrain. You still suffer its separate damage, restraints and hazards, and cannot cross impassable walls or surfaces without movement capability.

cards.name: Enhanced Stealth and Perception
cards.effect: Gain+2 Stealth and Perception. It does not stack with Keen Senses on Perception; use+2 total from these class features. Advantage from another feature is separate.

cards.name: Tactical Draw
cards.target: Self after switching melee/ranged weapon mode
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC after making an attack with the new mode. Drawing/stowing alone is insufficient. Further switches refresh neither extra AC nor actions.

cards.name: Vigilant Heart
cards.effect: You cannot be surprised by a creature you can perceive. Gain advantage on saves against scrying; on success learn someone attempted it but not identity/location. No blanket immunity to divination.

cards.name: Dual Style
cards.effect: Draw/stow a bow and up to 2 light melee weapons as one free exchange on your turn. This replaces normal object interaction for those weapons and cannot manipulate unrelated items or grant attacks.

cards.name: Elemental Imbue
cards.effect: Use the engine's fire/cold/poison Imbue: once/turn add 1d4 and its bounded elemental rider to a weapon hit. Switching element pays again. It does not stack multiple imbues or multiply Do Ts.

cards.name: Pathfinder's Mark
cards.target: One fixed visible point within 30 ft
cards.effect: Know direction and rough distance to the point within 10 miles on same plane. A new mark replaces old. It does not create teleportation, observe occupants or reveal a path through barriers.

cards.name: Natural Camouflage
cards.effect: Take Hide with advantage if foliage, rock or other natural cover can conceal you. Being stationary in open view does not qualify. Does not grant invisibility or hide your allies.

cards.name: Terrain Analysis
cards.effect: Learn up to 2 observable tactical facts: difficult ground, unstable footing, tracks or usable cover. Director states facts supported by senses; hidden magical traps still need normal checks. Next ally following your identified safe route gains+5 ft movement once.

cards.name: Swift Traverse
cards.effect: Take Dash, gaining movement equal to Speed; ignore opportunity attacks from your quarry during this movement only. No free attacks, flight, wall traversal or doubled daily travel rate.

cards.name: Predator's Mark
cards.effect: Upgrade current mark: first direct weapon hit per turn adds 1d6 rather than the engine's flat S; choose the higher, not both. Know quarry direction while within 90 ft unless blocked by total cover. Requires concentration; ordinary mark remains if this upgrade ends.

cards.name: Living Pulse
cards.effect: You may pay 1 RP to regain 2 HP. Does not trigger when Downed or incapacitated, cannot exceed maximum and never counts as another healing spell. Replaces unlimited passive regeneration with a finite cost.

cards.name: Beast Empathy
cards.target: Natural beasts within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: Communicate simple emotions/directions. They are not automatically friendly or controlled, cannot answer beyond their experience, and may need normal Animal Handling. No language-based compulsion or extra companion slot.

cards.name: Warden's Vigilance
cards.effect: Learn direction of one substantial recent fire, poisoning or unnatural blight in the area. Does not locate arbitrary enemies or identify culprits. A protected or planar-hidden effect may remain undetected.

cards.name: Healing Touch
cards.target: One other ally healed by your paid spell/item
cards.effect: Add M HP to actual healing. Do not multiply potion dice or duplicate consumed items; cannot apply to regeneration, companions' healing, copies or another Ranger's same bonus.

cards.name: Rootcall Quake
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
cards.effect: STR save or Speed 0. Each affected target repeats save at end of each turn and may use Action to attempt escape using STR(Athletics) against class DC. Flying creatures not touching ground are unaffected.

cards.name: Healing Briar
cards.target: Fixed 10 ft-radius natural-ground zone within 30 ft; 3 allies/pulse
cards.effect: On start heal 1d8+M per chosen living ally; on next 2 turns Bonus Action+1 RP repeats pulse. Maximum 3 pulses; no passive additional entry healing and no Wound removal.

cards.name: Warden's Step
cards.target: Empty space adjacent to injured ally within 30 ft
cards.duration: Instant; pressure until start next turn
cards.effect: Teleport to visible legal space. Up to 2 adjacent enemies make WIS save; failure gives disadvantage on next attack against someone other than you. No forced targeting, movement or whole-Action loss.

cards.name: Nature's Blessing
cards.effect: Ally gains+10 ft Speed and S d6+M temporary HP on start. While effect lasts it has advantage on saves against forced movement. Temporary HP are not refreshed each turn.

cards.name: Beast Companion
cards.cost: 4 RP; 1 hour with a willing/tamed eligible beast
cards.effect: Bond eligible beast using standard companion stats plus Wisdom modifier HP; preserve one movement mode up to 40 ft and keen-sense advantage. Bonus Action command gives one attack, no imported boss powers. Injury persists; heal normally. Death requires a new bond after long rest, not free resummoning.

cards.name: Hunter's Reflex
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC against the next ranged attack targeting you. Benefit ends after that attack, hit or miss. Multiple shots do not create multiple dodge charges.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.effect: Leave no mundane footprints and make no ordinary footstep sound. You still need cover and Stealth to hide; speech, equipment noise, scent, tremorsense and magical tracking remain possible.

cards.name: Keen Hunter
cards.effect: If quarry attempts to Hide while visible to you, you know its position until it gains total cover or leaves your sight. Does not negate invisibility, darkness or planar travel without an appropriate sense.

cards.name: Efficient Killer
cards.target: Your Hit Chain after class 11 unlock
cards.effect: Arrow threshold becomes 2 successful direct weapon hits instead of 3; gain cap remains 2/turn. The source of an Arrow's combo prerequisite still needs its stated history; Emberroot/Glacial may require 3 hits even though chain is primed at 2.

cards.name: Camouflage Step
cards.target: Self in natural cover or dim light
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack/cast
cards.effect: Become invisible; ends immediately after your first attack roll or spell cast, hit or miss. No automatic surprise. Taking damage does not itself end it, but ordinary senses can locate you.

cards.name: Silent Volley
cards.target: Up to 3 distinct enemies in bow range
cards.effect: Make 3 bow attacks, each weapon die without ability damage modifier. Ignore half cover, not armor or total cover. Quarry/riders once per their limits; chain gains at most 2. This is not three full Attack Actions.

cards.name: Shattershot
cards.duration: Instant; shield suppression until end next turn
cards.effect: One bow attack; hit adds S d6 piercing. Target makes STR save or loses its shield's AC bonus until end next turn. One visible rank 1–3 magical defense can instead be suppressed after a WIS save failure; never permanently destroys gear or dispels everything.

cards.name: Ghost Strike
cards.effect: One melee weapon attack with+2 to hit; on hit add S d6 force. Only added force ignores resistance, not immunity. Does not remove natural armor, all AC or legendary defenses.

cards.name: Vanishing Act
cards.duration: Until start next turn or attack/cast
cards.effect: Teleport to unoccupied visible space and become invisible until the stated end. Cannot pass a ward that blocks teleportation, escape a dimensional prison or retain invisibility after attacking.

cards.name: Predator's Grin
cards.target: Self after directly reducing quarry to 0
cards.effect: Gain one extra full Action next turn within the shared cap. It cannot grant another Action or trigger another Predator's Grin. Allies, summons, helpless creatures and ongoing copied damage do not qualify.

cards.name: Toxic Affinity
cards.effect: Immune to Poisoned and nonmagical disease; gain poison resistance. This deliberately replaces blanket immunity to every poison/disease source. Existing magical diseases require their own treatment.

cards.name: Corruption Touch
cards.effect: Imbue lasts 6 turns instead of 3. On a weapon critical, one other enemy within 5 ft takes 1d4 of imbue type. No additional condition, Hit Chain or recursive critical effects on that secondary damage.

cards.name: Blight Infusion
cards.target: Primary target of your Arrow on blighted ground
cards.effect: On hit target makes CON save or the next HP healing it receives is reduced by M, minimum 0. This is temporary Blight, not permanent campaign Corruption; multiple applications do not stack.

cards.name: Venom Rain
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius area within 60 ft
cards.duration: Instant; Poisoned until end next turn
cards.effect: CON save: S d8 poison, half on success; failure Poisoned until end next turn. No permanent Corruption gain, contagious disease or poison harvesting. This is a paid technique and does not build Hit Chain.

cards.name: Rotting Tether
cards.target: One enemy standing on ground within 60 ft
cards.effect: CON save or tethered: first time it voluntarily moves at least 5 ft each turn, takes S d4 necrotic. Repeat save at turn end ends tether. Forced movement causes no damage; maximum 1 tick/turn, no whole-turn loss.

cards.name: Entropic March
cards.target: Fixed 15 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
cards.effect: Create temporary blighted difficult terrain. On start and first entry/start of turn, up to 3 enemies take S d4 necrotic, CON half, maximum once/creature/round. Ground returns unchanged afterward; no permanent ecological corruption or resource farming.

cards.name: Withering Shot
cards.duration: Instant; until end target's next turn
cards.effect: Bow attack; hit adds S d6 necrotic and target makes CON save. Failure halves the next HP healing it receives before expiry, rounding down. No stacking with another reduction to create negative healing.

cards.name: Plague Bearer
cards.effect: Your first weapon hit each turn adds 1d6 poison; target CON save or Poisoned until end next turn. You lose M real HP on activation, cannot fall below 1. The controlled effect is not a transmissible permanent disease and creates no free toxins.

cards.name: Master of the Hunt — new Hero capstone
cards.effect: New playtest Hero capstone. Once per long rest when using your Hero Arrow, pay its normal Hit Chain/action requirements, then enhance only that activation: Warder grants 2 M temporary HP instead of M; Stalker adds S d6 piercing to one of its two hits; Outrider adds S d4 necrotic to one target on its single pulse. No extra Arrow, Hit Chain, action or copied proc.

engine: Wisdom is the class ability. Choose Elemental Affinity automatically at 1: Fire, Ice, Air or Earth. Spellcasting/RP remain separate from Totem objects and flasks. Totem capacity 1, rises 2 at 13; any third replaces one of your existing totems. A totem is a visible Tiny magical object: AC 12+PB, HP 2 L, immobile, immune to poison/psychic/conditions, vulnerable to ordinary weapon and other damage. At 0 HP its aura ends. A new totem appears within 30 ft; cannot occupy a creature's space, serve as a bridge, trap a creature without a save or move through walls.

Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

On your turn you may spend Bonus Action to move one totem up to 15 ft along unobstructed ground, remaining within 60 ft. This competes with healing maintenance, companion commands and advanced flasks. Moving an aura over a creature cannot trigger its once/round effect repeatedly. Totem destruction creates no resource return. Once per round, the first ordinary spell cast while inside your own active totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0; no RP reduction.

The book places Flask Use at Base but describes advanced flask casting as Theurgist/Soothsayer-only. For this draft, Base Flask Use grants mundane prepared tactical flasks thrown with an Action; at Hero 10 only Theurgist/Soothsayer gain magical Bonus Action flasks. Bloodcaller retains mundane alchemical knowledge, not the advanced flask subsystem. At long rest prepare 2 flasks, rising to 3 at 5 and 4 at 11; no encounter refill or stockpiling, total carry cap 4, unused contents become inert when preparing a new batch. This finite-rest supply replaces encounter-based free heal farming.

Flask tier uses S. Mundane Base modes: Burn=one enemy 30 ft DEX save S d6 fire half, failure 1d4 fire next turn; Root=one ground enemy 30 ft STR save Speed 0 until end its next turn; Weaken=one enemy 30 ft CON save or-1 attack damage until end its next turn. Advanced Hero modes additionally: Stun=one enemy 30 ft CON save or no Reactions, failure by 10 Stunned until end its next turn; Heal=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Restore=end Frightened or Poisoned on one ally 30 ft. Every thrown flask consumes one prepared unit and 2 RP for advanced magic (Base mundane flasks cost 0 RP). Changing payload requires no separate crafting action when throwing. No flask leaves harvestable poison or another flask.

Choose Fire/Ice/Air/Earth bonuses through affinity card; Ember/Cold/Shock damage are fire/cold/lightning, Earth uses bludgeoning. Summoned elemental spirits use one standard companion each, maximum one normally; Elemental Chorus expressly summons a package of 4 but all share one Bonus Action command and a printed combined pulse. Companions cannot generate RP, trigger flask refunds or create corpse/kill farms.

Bloodcaller at Hero 10 transforms permanently into Hagraven, with the player choosing this class path and its stated loss of ordinary Shaman spellcasting. It does NOT lose its RP reservoir: printed Hagraven/Totem techniques still pay RP, but it cannot cast ordinary Shaman spells or advanced magical flasks. It retains prior totem/technique selections. The change is a class choice, not permission for involuntary player-character conversion; ancestry identity and player control remain. At long rest it can prepare mundane flasks only if Base Flask Use is known.

Shaman Base 1–2, Spiritwalker Arch 3–9, and Theurgist/Soothsayer/Bloodcaller Hero 10–20 remain separate stages. Elemental Affinity is automatic 1, not an extra selection cost. No explicit Arch capstone in source:9 has its ordinary choice. At 20 your selected Hero's last active ultimate gains the explicit new capstone improvement below; no new generic Hero class is invented.
classes.protected: Once per round, the first spell cast inside the Shaman's own active Totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance (minimum 0).
example: Shaman 5, WIS 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3, RP 12. Know Totem Casting, Spirit Shock, Flask Use, Elemental Ward at 1. Prepare 3 mundane flasks after a real long rest. Totem capacity 1.
Turn 1: Action Totem Casting places Renewal within 30 ft, pays 2 RP (12→10). Up to 3 allies inside regain 2 HP each. One concentration effect is active.
Turn 2: Bonus Action maintenance pays 1 RP (10→9), heals 2 HP to up to 3 allies. Action Spirit Shock costs 2 RP (9→7) and deals 2d8 on failed save. No extra flask Bonus Action remains.
Turn 3: Bonus Action+1 RP Renewal maintenance (7→6), final 2 HP pulse. Action throws one mundane Root flask, prepared count 3→2, no RP; target STR save. Its save success gives no refund.
At start turn 4 totem expires. Placing a new Renewal costs full 2 RP and starts another finite 3 pulse effect. Encounter end does not refill flasks or RP.
At Hero 10 a Bloodcaller still uses this totem/technique loop, but cannot cast ordinary Shaman spells or advanced Bonus Action magical flasks.

cards.name: Elemental Affinity
cards.effect: Choose Fire: first fire technique hit/turn adds 1 damage; Ice: first cold damage target/turn loses 5 ft Speed until end next turn; Air:+5 ft Speed; Earth:+1 on STR/CON saves against forced movement. These are alternatives, not cumulative affinities.

cards.name: Spirit Sight
cards.effect: Perceive location/outline of invisible spirits and elementals not behind total cover. This does not reveal unrelated invisible creatures, private memories or all magical traps. No attack advantage against ordinary hidden creatures.

cards.name: Alchemical Knowledge
cards.effect: Gain advantage on INT(Arcana) or alchemist-tool checks to identify a substance's mundane ingredients and likely purpose. Identification does not guarantee safety or supply a recipe/materials; failure yields uncertainty, not false certainty.

cards.name: Primal Resilience
cards.effect: Resistance to affinity damage: Fire fire, Ice cold, Air lightning, Earth thunder. Does not stack with another resistance or grant immunity to related terrain hazards.

cards.name: Ancestral Whispers
cards.target: Self just failing a Perception or initiative-related check
cards.effect: Reroll with+M, using the new result. Requires ability to hear the spirit warning; cannot reroll a save/attack or retroactively undo a completed ambush round.

cards.name: Flask Use
cards.effect: Throw a Burn, Root or Weaken flask using the exact engine profile. At Hero 10 Theurgist/Soothsayer may instead throw an advanced mode as Bonus Action for 2 RP and a prepared flask. Bloodcaller does not gain that upgrade.

cards.name: Totem Casting
cards.target: One totem within 30 ft with 15 ft aura
cards.effect: Place one Flame/Stone/Frost/Spirit/Renewal totem using the engine's exact profile. All your totems share concentration. Respect 3 creature aura/pulse limit; same-stat bonuses do not stack. Replacing a totem ends it without refund.

cards.name: Spirit Shock
cards.effect: Target makes DEX save: S d8 affinity damage, half on success. Affinity rider applies once; this printed technique is not an ordinary spell, cannot Overcast and does not generate a flask or totem.

cards.name: Commune with Spirits
cards.target: Local spirit within 30 ft or area examined
cards.effect: Ask about events the local spirit could have perceived within the previous day. Director gives truthful sensory information or unknown. No compelled omniscience, future certainty or forced player beliefs.

cards.name: Elemental Ward
cards.target: Self or ally within 15 ft taking elemental damage
cards.effect: Reduce acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder damage by S d6+M, minimum 0. No reflected damage or resource gain. Does not protect from unrelated physical/psychic damage.

cards.name: Enhanced Elemental Attunement
cards.effect: Fire adds 1 to first fire damage roll; Ice's slow increases to 10 ft; Air also gives+1 initiative; Earth adds+1 to CON concentration saves. These replace corresponding basic affinity quantities rather than duplicating them.

cards.name: Extended Totem Duration
cards.cost: 0; full upkeep for extra Renewal pulse
cards.effect: Totems last 1 extra turn. Renewal may have a fourth pulse only if you pay Bonus Action+1 RP on that turn; no fifth pulse and no automatic free healing. Concentration still required.

cards.name: Spirit Cache
cards.target: One flask/to-tem effect you directly used
cards.effect: Store its profile, not an active copy. On a later turn use normal Action/Bonus Action and pay all RP and a new flask unit or full totem cost to repeat it. Add 1d6 to one numerical damage/heal amount; no copy of refund/limited use.

cards.name: Totem Pulse
cards.target: Up to 3 creatures inside newly placed non-healing totem
cards.effect: On placement pay 1 RP: allies gain M temporary HP OR enemies make DEX save for S affinity damage, half on success. No immediate second Renewal healing pulse, no repeat from moving the totem.

cards.name: Spirit Saturation
cards.effect: Waive its 2 RP placement cost once. Still use Action, concentration, capacity and any added costs. Cannot create a healing totem or be cached/refunded to generate more free casts.

cards.name: Elemental Channeling
cards.effect: Embody affinity: gain+10 ft Speed and once/turn add 1d4 affinity damage to a weapon hit. Fire/cold/lightning/bludgeoning by affinity. This concentration replaces your totem burden, so it is a tactical alternative.

cards.name: Spirit Walk
cards.effect: Move up to 15 ft through creatures and nonmagical material no thicker than 5 ft, ending in a visible empty space. Gain no attack immunity; take 1d6 force if no legal exit and return to starting space. No attacks/casts while inside matter.

cards.name: Ancestral Guardian
cards.effect: A guardian prevents S d8+M damage, minimum 0. It then vanishes and creates no companion action, corpse or refund. Cannot prevent sacrifice/trauma or redirect prevented damage into another trigger.

cards.name: Elemental Surge
cards.effect: Choose one: aura radius+5 ft OR numerical flat benefit improves by 1. Renewal instead adds M HP to its next paid pulse, once, without adding a pulse. Same-name/stat stacking rules remain.

cards.name: Spirit Binding
cards.target: One willing ally or held object within 30 ft
cards.effect: Ally gains resistance to your affinity damage; OR its held weapon adds 1d4 affinity damage on first hit/turn. Choose one, fixed for duration. Spirit cannot cast independently or grant spell knowledge.

cards.name: Echo Totem
cards.target: Adjacent empty space within 5 ft of newly placed totem
cards.effect: Create a weak echo anchor of that totem. It counts toward capacity; if no space in capacity, cannot create it. Its radius 10 ft and numerical bonuses/healing are half, rounded down. Shared concentration/upkeep and same-name nonstacking prevent double healing.

cards.name: Elemental Harmony
cards.effect: Add class level to its maximum/current HP on creation and 1 turn duration, maximum 4 turns for class summons. Cannot extend once/day Chorus beyond 4 turns or restore an existing creature's lost HP.

cards.name: Spiritual Resonance
cards.target: Two of your active totems within 10 ft of one another
cards.effect: Their aura radii increase 5 ft. No extra targets or extra pulses and overlapping same-name benefits do not stack. One totem and its echo still use normal capacity.

cards.name: Benevolent Spirits
cards.target: One ally below half HP healed by your paid technique
cards.effect: Add M HP to that healing. It does not improve multiple targets, copies or triggered heals, and cannot itself trigger Benevolent Spirits again.

cards.name: Summon Ice Wisp
cards.target: One spirit in empty space within 30 ft
cards.effect: Summon standard Ice Wisp with fly 30 ft. Commanded attack deals cold; on hit target STR save or Speed 0 until end its next turn. No whole-turn freezing, bonus independent spells or multiple companion attacks.

cards.name: Summon Airling
cards.effect: Summon standard Airling with fly 40 ft. Commanded attack deals lightning; on hit target CON save or loses Reactions until end its next turn. Failure by 10 also Stunned once/target/encounter. One shared companion command.

cards.name: Summon Cinderflame
cards.effect: Summon standard Cinderflame. Commanded hit deals fire plus Burn 1d4 next target turn. On destruction only (not dismissal), up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX save for S d4 fire, half. Explosion creates no further death/resource triggers.

cards.name: Summon Stonekin
cards.effect: Summon standard Stonekin. Command chooses bludgeoning attack with STR save or Prone on hit, OR gives up to 3 adjacent allies reduction 2 until start next turn. No simultaneous attack and protection command.

cards.name: Elemental Chorus
cards.target: Four spirits in 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft
cards.effect: Summon a single Chorus package: four visible spirits share HP 4 L, AC 12+PB, immobile. Bonus Action command pulses up to 3 enemies: DEX save S d6 chosen affinity damage half; one failed target Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Four spirits do not make four separate attacks.

cards.name: Divining Totem
cards.target: One divining totem within 30 ft; observed enemy in aura
cards.effect: Each own-turn start choose one visible enemy in 15 ft aura. First ally attack against it before your next turn gains+1 to hit; first attack it makes has-1. Predicts immediate intent, not guaranteed future actions; totem has ordinary object stats.

cards.name: Predictive Alchemy
cards.effect: Retain the spent flask count once, but still pay RP/Action and all other costs. This deterministic refund cannot be copied, cached or apply to another refunded use. Carry cap 4 remains.

cards.name: Fate's Whisper
cards.target: Self before making a saving throw
cards.effect: Gain advantage on that save. Must declare before rolling; no additional reroll if advantage already applies. Does not create a Prophecy Trigger or restore RP.

cards.name: Balanced Elements
cards.effect: Choose one application: add 1 damage to its next Burn tick OR extend a Speed reduction until end target's following turn. Never extends Stunned, silence, concentration duration or whole-Action denial.

cards.name: Delayed Detonation
cards.effect: Set a flask to trigger at start next turn or first enemy entering 5 ft before then; choose when placing. On trigger one creature within 5 ft resolves its normal payload/save. If no target when timer ends it is spent harmlessly. No repeated explosions.

cards.name: Healing Splash
cards.target: Up to 3 living allies in 5 ft radius within 30 ft
cards.effect: Each regains S d6+M HP, shared roll. This consumes a flask and replaces its normal payload. No damage to enemies, free conditions removed or resource refunds beyond the explicit once/day Predictive Alchemy.

cards.name: Omen Brand
cards.effect: Next ally attack against target has advantage and ignores half cover; not an automatic hit. If attack misses the brand ends. Cannot override total cover, immunity or target legality.

cards.name: Fate Weaving
cards.target: One creature within 60 ft just rolled an attack/save/check
cards.effect: Force one d20 reroll after result known but before consequence, using new result. Cannot reroll damage, resource quantities, a reroll or an already resolved event. No beliefs or future outcomes guaranteed.

cards.name: Omen Loop
cards.cost: Normal RP+2 RP; fresh flask if required; 1 long-rest use
cards.target: Your own qualifying effect used within previous 2 turns
cards.effect: Repeat one non-Finale, non-resource-restoring class flask/totem effect with normal targets and full costs. It replaces the current Action; cannot repeat another repeat, regain per-rest uses or exceed totem capacity. If effect required a flask, consume one now.

cards.name: Hagraven Form
cards.effect: Become Hagraven: retain player control/mental stats, light-armor use and ordinary movement; claws are finesse 1d6 slashing, darkvision 60 ft and poison resistance. Lose ordinary Shaman spellcasting/advanced magical flasks; retain RP for printed techniques and totems. No free flight or hidden monster stat block.

cards.name: Blood Feast
cards.target: Self at start regular turn; hostile bleeding creature within 10 ft
cards.effect: Pay 1 RP to regain M HP. Bleeding allies, summons or staged captives cannot qualify. No healing while Downed; secondary heal creates no damage/resource triggers.

cards.name: Necrotic Aura
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies within 10 ft at your turn start
cards.effect: Pay 1 RP; CON save S d4 necrotic, half on success. This replaces unlimited free aura damage. Cannot trigger itself, create Bleed or generate additional RP from kills.

cards.name: Spell Resistance
cards.effect: Advantage on saving throws against spells. Does not give advantage against every supernatural weapon or class technique unless it is explicitly a spell; no automatic spell negation or RP refund.

cards.name: Blight Totem
cards.target: Totem within 30 ft; 15 ft aura affecting all creatures
cards.effect: HP healing received inside aura is halved, rounding down, including allies and you. Nonstacking with another healing reduction; temporary HP unaffected. This totem has standard object stats and grants no free damage/healing.

cards.name: Blood Curse
cards.effect: CON save or Bleed 1d4 necrotic at start of each of next 3 turns. Action plus successful Medicine check against class DC ends it; magical healing also permits an immediate CON save to end. Never permanently unhealable; no repeated stacking.

cards.name: Talon Strike
cards.duration: Instant; reduction until end next turn
cards.effect: Make one claw attack; hit adds S d6 necrotic and reduces the next healing it receives by M, minimum 0. Applies once and ends. No arbitrary percent stacking or permanent maximum-HP reduction.

cards.name: Death Shriek
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies within 15 ft that hear you
cards.duration: Until end each target's next turn
cards.effect: WIS save or Frightened and disadvantage on next concentration save. It still gets ordinary Actions and new saves normally; repeats WIS save at turn end to end fear early. Not automatic failure or total spell disable.

cards.name: Bloodroot Trail
cards.target: Up to 30 ft of ground traversed this turn, 5 ft wide
cards.effect: Leave a visible bloodroot trail, no solid wall. Each enemy first entering/starting on it per round makes DEX save for S d6 necrotic, half on success; failure Bleed 1d4 next turn. Maximum 3 creatures damaged/round chosen in entry order; no persistent corruption after expiry.

cards.name: Elder Spirit Accord — new Hero capstone
cards.effect: When starting Elemental Chorus, Omen Loop or Bloodroot Trail, reduce its RP cost by 3, minimum 1, and add M to one damage/healing roll from that use. You must know that ability and still spend its own limited use. If you do not know it, instead reduce one known Hero technique's RP cost by 3, minimum 1. No extra duration, flask, totem, command or repeated cast.

engine: A martial class with d10 Hit Die, all armor and shields, repeating crossbows, sidearms and siege tools. Dexterity governs ranged attacks; Constitution governs class DC/M and defensive techniques. No RP, ordinary spellcasting, Refrain or Dissonance engine. Names such as Divine Lockdown describe disciplined suppression; they do not grant divine magic.

Overwatch is an automatic Base engine at 1. Bonus Action designate a visible 15 ft square within weapon range until start next regular turn. Once during that interval, spend your Reaction when a perceived enemy enters, moves inside, attacks an ally from, or reveals itself inside the zone. Make one legal ranged attack with ammunition and line of fire, normally 1d8+DEX piercing. On hit choose Snare (Speed-10 ft until end next turn), Bleed (1d4 at start next turn), or Push 5 ft (STR save negates push). Concealment still applies. Only one Overwatch zone; no extra Reaction. The optional Overwatch card upgrades this engine. At 17 you may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks after its shot, once/round.

At 5 automatically gain Palisade Deployment. Spend one carried barricade kit and an Action to erect a 2-by 1-tile wall in contiguous unoccupied ground within 5 ft. Height 5 ft, AC 12, HP 5+CON modifier minimum 1, immunity psychic/poison; blocks movement and line of sight across its full height but can be climbed using 10 ft movement. One kit/use per encounter, two at 13; a long rest with carpentry tools replenishes 2 kits (carried maximum 2, reusable parts have no resale value). Material is required; no conjuring. At most one intact wall, two at 13. Old wall must be dismantled in 1 minute before replacement beyond cap. Once per encounter an Action repairs a wall for M HP using spare parts; destruction does not refresh uses.

Palisade Tier II at 13 doubles wall HP and grants resistance to damage from area effects. Hold Position: while adjacent to your intact wall gain+1 AC and+1 saves. Brace Line: an ally immediately behind you relative to a ranged attacker, with your wall adjacent to both of you, has 2 flat DR against that attacker. These bonuses do not stack with another Soldier wall; strongest flat DR applies. Full cover prevents attacks rather than granting an additional AC bonus.

Base 1–2, Commander Arch 3–9, then Champion/Artillerist/Tyrant Hero 10–20. Palisade 5 is automatic; Intercepting Shot has minimum 6 and Fortify Zone 9. Other cards require selection. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. At 20 gain the new Final Command below, clearly a playtest addition. No spell or sustained technique may be used to obtain infinite ammunition, structures, actions or permanent healing.
classes.protected: No general Weave casting; class power is entirely positional and martial.
example: Soldier 6, DEX 16, CON 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3. Carry 2 barricade kits and begin with one encounter deployment available.
Turn 1 Action deploy a 10-by 5 ft wall: kits 2→1, encounter uses 1→0, wall HP 8. Bonus Action designate Overwatch. Standing adjacent grants+1 AC/+1 saves.
Enemy moves inside zone; Reaction attack hits for 1d8+3. Choose Snare: Speed-10 ft through end of its next turn. You cannot also use Intercepting Shot before your Reaction refreshes.
Turn 2 use Covering Fire: one ranged attack with its printed rider. You cannot add an ordinary Attack Action. Renew Overwatch with Bonus Action; its next shot still needs your Reaction.

If the wall is destroyed, encounter deployment stays 0. An intact wall could receive its once/encounter repair for 3 HP. After combat a new encounter still requires a carried kit; long rest restores at most 2 kits.

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.effect: Increase zone to 20 ft square. After a qualifying enemy triggers it you may decline the shot and keep waiting until zone expires. Still only one Reaction shot and normal sight requirements.

cards.name: Shield Trained
cards.effect: Wield a repeating crossbow with a strapped shield; reloading still needs an available hand or the repeating mechanism. If you have moved 0 ft since start last turn gain 1 flat DR. Forced movement ends the benefit.

cards.name: Tactical Awareness
cards.effect: Gain+2 Perception and initiative. Does not reveal unseen creatures automatically or allow attacks without line of fire.

cards.name: Defensive Positioning
cards.target: Self adjacent to solid terrain or your cover
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Does not stack with Hold Position or another copy of this feature; full cover follows ordinary rules.

cards.name: Steady Aim
cards.effect: Ignore the AC bonus from half cover. Three-quarter and full cover still apply; this is not permission to shoot through allies or walls.

cards.name: Covering Fire
cards.effect: Make one ranged weapon attack. On hit normal damage and target has-2 on its next attack against an ally other than you. Further Covering Fire replaces rather than stacks this penalty.

cards.name: Quick Deploy
cards.effect: Place low cover from carried field supplies: AC 12, HP 5, grants half cover and is difficult terrain. It is not a full palisade and does not grant its bonuses. One at a time; no transferable saleable material.

cards.name: Warning Shot
cards.effect: Make a ranged attack; on hit deal weapon die only and impose disadvantage on its next attack. Does not force it to attack or expend an action.

cards.name: Tactical Reposition
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks. Requires an open route; no teleporting, escaping restraints or attacks.

cards.name: Rally Point
cards.target: Up to 3 allies within 15 ft who hear you
cards.effect: Each gains M temporary HP and+1 on the next saving throw before duration ends. Temporary HP follows strongest-only rule and is lost at encounter end.

cards.name: Command Step
cards.effect: After you take an Action, ally may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks. No extra action, attack, teleport or movement through blocked spaces.

cards.name: Formation Lock
cards.effect: Enemies gain no flanking bonus from surrounding protected creatures. Other sources of advantage and cover remain; allies need not spend reactions.

cards.name: Iron Orders
cards.target: Up to 3 allies within 15 ft who hear you
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC and+1 saves against Frightened. This AC bonus does not stack with other Soldier formation/aura AC bonuses; use highest.

cards.name: Palisade Deployment
cards.effect: Automatic engine, not a selected skill. Build the palisade with the exact statistics, kit and repair rules in the class engine. Source minimum 5 retained.

cards.name: Intercepting Shot
cards.target: Attacker within 25 ft that you perceive
cards.effect: When it hits an ally within 25 ft, attack it before damage. On your hit reduce triggering damage by S+M, minimum 0. Your shot deals weapon die only. Does not undo a hit or block an area effect against everyone.

cards.name: Fortify Zone
cards.effect: Designate fortified firing lanes. Ranged attacks against up to 3 allies inside take-2 to hit while you remain conscious within 30 ft. Does not affect saves, melee attacks or attacks from inside zone.

cards.name: Tactical Assessment
cards.effect: Learn its current armor category and whether it has cover. Choose one ally: their next attack against it gains+1 to hit. No hidden statistics, mind-reading or vulnerability invention.

cards.name: Coordinated Maneuver
cards.target: One willing ally within 30 ft who hears you
cards.effect: Ally spends Reaction to move up to half Speed and make one weapon attack. This is one granted attack, not a full Attack Action; no Extra Attack. Counts against shared extra-action/attack grant cap for that ally this round.

cards.name: Suppression Fire
cards.effect: Up to 3 perceived enemies in zone make DEX save. Failure: S d6 piercing and Speed-10 ft through end next turn; success half damage, no slow. Cannot shoot through full cover. No attack rolls or on-hit procs.

cards.name: Defensive Formation
cards.target: Up to 3 willing allies within 15 ft
cards.effect: Each may shift 5 ft without opportunity attacks and gains 1 flat DR while adjacent to another affected ally. Uses strongest DR, not an additive stack.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.target: One enemy entering your melee reach
cards.effect: Make one melee weapon attack. On hit normal damage and STR save or Speed 0. This is soft movement control; teleportation and forced movement remain possible.

cards.name: Protective Aura
cards.effect: Advantage on saves against Frightened or Charmed. Does not end existing effects automatically or grant immunity to all mental effects.

cards.name: Selfless Guardian
cards.target: One adjacent ally taking direct weapon damage
cards.effect: Redirect up to S+M of that damage to yourself. Redirected damage cannot be reduced, redirected again or trigger retaliation. The ally takes the rest after its own mitigation.

cards.name: Inspiring Presence
cards.target: Allies within 15 ft who hear you
cards.effect: Gain+2 on saves against fear and checks to rally a routed formation. No generic bonus to all saves or attacks; does not stack with Iron Orders fear bonus.

cards.name: Defensive Expertise
cards.effect: Gain 2 flat DR against weapon damage. Use strongest DR; does not stack with Shield Trained, wall protection or Wall of Aegis.

cards.name: Guardian's Rush
cards.target: One ally within 15 ft hit by attack
cards.effect: Move up to 15 ft along open ground to adjacent ally without opportunity attacks; reduce that hit's damage by 2 S+M. Cannot act while restrained or incapacitated. Does not transfer target or negate unrelated riders.

cards.name: Divine Lockdown
cards.effect: STR save each; failure Speed 0 and cannot take Reactions. Success Speed-10 ft only. This is physical suppression; teleport remains possible. No damage or additional free attacks.

cards.name: Wall of Aegis
cards.target: Self and up to 3 adjacent allies
cards.duration: Until start of your second next turn
cards.effect: Gain 2 flat DR against all damage except psychic. Use strongest reduction once per damage packet; does not stack with other flat DR.

cards.name: Rallying Cry
cards.target: Up to 3 allies within 30 ft who hear you
cards.duration: Instant; temp HP to encounter end
cards.effect: End Frightened on each and grant S+M temporary HP. Cannot revive, heal real HP or repeatedly refresh from imitation/copies.

cards.name: Sacrificial Defense
cards.target: One adjacent ally that would reach 0 HP from damage
cards.effect: Reduce damage by up to your current HP minus 1, taking that amount as unmitigable damage yourself. Ally takes remainder. Cannot make either creature's HP negative, erase massive-damage rules or transfer the cost again.

cards.name: Enhanced Overwatch
cards.effect: A hidden enemy that attacks or moves inside must roll Stealth against your passive Perception; failure reveals its space until turn end. Invisibility still imposes its normal attack penalty. Total cover blocks detection and firing.

cards.name: Tactical Reload
cards.effect: Reload its ordinary magazine without an action, consuming carried ammunition. No infinite ammunition or additional shots; incompatible with ammunition you cannot physically load.

cards.name: Palisade Synergy
cards.target: Your ranged weapon attack while adjacent to palisade
cards.effect: Add S damage. Does not apply to every shot, area save or turret hit, and requires an intact wall you deployed.

cards.name: Precision Engineering
cards.effect: Increase maximum and initial HP by M. Does not heal existing damaged structures when learned or moved; repairing remains finite.

cards.name: Net Bolt
cards.effect: Ranged weapon attack; on hit S d4 bludgeoning and Restrained. Target or adjacent ally may use Action STR/Athletics against your DC to end, or destroy net AC 10 HP 5. Huge or larger targets instead lose 10 ft Speed. No automatic unsaveable imprisonment.

cards.name: Shatterburst
cards.effect: Up to 3 enemies DEX save, S d6 piercing on failure, half success. Failure also-1 attack rolls for duration. This save technique has no critical hits or weapon-hit riders.

cards.name: Repel Shot
cards.target: Enemy within 30 ft moving toward you
cards.effect: Ranged attack; on hit weapon die damage and STR save or pushed 10 ft away. No pushing through walls or into occupied squares; it can continue remaining movement afterward.

cards.name: Turret Deployment
cards.target: Up to 2 empty squares within 10 ft
cards.effect: Deploy 2 turrets, each AC 12+PB and HP 2 L, immobile, range 60 ft. On your Bonus Action command ONE turret to attack using PB+DEX for 1d6+M piercing. Both share that single command/attack budget with other companions; no autonomous shots. Reclaimed after use, no resale.

cards.name: Bubble of Discipline
cards.duration: Until start of your second next turn
cards.effect: Deploy dense layered cover. Up to 3 allies inside gain+2 AC against spell attacks and advantage on DEX saves against spells from outside. Once total, Reaction reduce spell damage to one protected ally by 2 S+M. Does not negate a spell, block internal casting or protect each ally independently.

cards.name: Intimidating Presence
cards.target: Enemies within 10 ft that perceive you
cards.effect: They take-1 on saves against your Frightened effects. Never alters immunity or stacks multiple Tyrant penalties.

cards.name: Cruel Efficiency
cards.target: One enemy you hit with a weapon on successive regular turns
cards.effect: Second and later consecutive-turn hits against same enemy add S damage. Missing all attacks or changing target ends chain. Bonus never grows beyond S and excludes Overwatch/turrets/copies.

cards.name: Marked for Death
cards.effect: Mark foe. It takes-1 saves against your class effects and deals 1 less damage on its first hit against an ally other than you. One mark; penalty does not stack with Intimidating Presence.

cards.name: Ruthless Tactician
cards.effect: Gain advantage on one attack against a flanked enemy or enemy in difficult terrain. Terrain must actually impede it; creating harmless decoration does not qualify.

cards.name: Crushing Decree
cards.target: Up to 3 enemies within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: WIS save; failure has disadvantage on attacks against allies other than you while it can perceive you. It may move, cast nonattack spells or decline attacks; no compelled suicide or removed Action.

cards.name: Impale Line
cards.effect: Make one ranged attack against each, normal weapon damage. If both hit, both lose Reactions for duration. If only one target exists, no double attack against it and no reaction rider.

cards.name: Execution Zone
cards.effect: Designate zone. First time each round one enemy tries to leave, Reaction weapon attack; on hit normal damage and STR save or movement ends at boundary for current turn. Teleport/forced movement works. One shot across all targets, no impassable magical wall.

cards.name: Demoralizing Shot
cards.target: Visible enemy within range; up to 2 allies of it within 10 ft
cards.effect: Weapon attack normal damage. On hit secondary enemies WIS save or disadvantage on next attack. Director need not designate a privileged leader; source leadership fiction represented by visible example.

cards.name: Brutal Example
cards.target: One enemy below half HP in weapon range
cards.effect: Weapon attack; on hit add 2 S d6 damage. Up to 2 enemies within 10 ft of victim WIS save or Frightened of you for duration. No automatic death threshold or fear through immunity.

cards.name: Final Command
cards.target: Self and up to 3 willing allies within 30 ft who hear you
cards.effect: New Hero capstone. Allies may each move 10 ft without opportunity attacks and gain S+M temporary HP. You refresh one expended short-rest Soldier card, excluding Final Command and long-rest features. A refreshed card still costs its activation and ammunition; no extra turn or recursive resets.

engine: Dexterity governs weapons and class DC/M. Choose Intelligence or Wisdom for noncombat class tool/sense checks at 1. Hit Die d8; light armor, daggers, shortswords, thrown weapons and hand crossbows; thieves tools and poison kit. Sneak Attack is automatic at 1: once on your regular turn, add ceil(class level/2)d6 to one finesse/ranged weapon hit if you had advantage, an active ally threatens target within 5 ft, or target is suffering your Bleed/Poisoned/Crippled. Disadvantage prevents Sneak Attack even if canceled into a straight roll. A feature can explicitly grant Sneak Attack on a different qualifying hit but never more than once/regular turn. Copies, poison ticks and companions cannot Sneak Attack.

Prepare fictional poison doses with poison kit during a long rest: maximum 3 carried at 1, 4 at 10, 5 at 15, 6 at 20; refill to this cap, never stockpile or sell these class preparations. A destroyed/confiscated kit prevents preparation until replaced. One dose coats one melee weapon or 2 projectiles, lasts 1 minute or until 2 attack attempts; hit applies its effect, miss still spends an attempt. Apply Poison card improves Action coating to Bonus Action; baseline coating is Action. Do not coat the same weapon with multiple doses except Double Poison. Fictional reagents come from ordinary adventuring supplies; no real-world recipes. Creating an exotic source-approved recipe requires an adventure specimen and one successful INT+PB poison-kit check DC 15, one attempt per specimen. It replaces a known recipe, not unlimited extra doses.

At 1 know all four Tier I recipes, at 7 add Tier II, at 14 Tier III. Poison saving throws use Thief DC except preserved source fixed DC 12 becomes max(12, Thief DC) for Mindburn/Venombite. Unless stated damage/conditions require a failed CON save; initial weapon damage is unaffected. Critical riders also need this failed save. One ongoing instance of each recipe per target; another application refreshes rather than stacks. Maximum 2 simultaneous different poison recipes from you per target. Bleed never stops all healing by default, Poisoned means-1 attack rolls/ability checks (not every save), and Shaken means disadvantage on next fear save. Neither is a hidden full-turn disable.

Tier I: Bloodleech gives Bleed 1d4 at start next 2 target turns; critical restores 1d4 of your HP, once per dose. Crippler gives-1 on next attack before end next turn; critical also half Speed for that duration. Mindburn uses WIS save: -1 spell-attack rolls until end next turn, critical also no Reactions. Venombite gives Poisoned until end next turn; critical also-1 on next save. Tier II: Ashblood adds 2d6 poison now and 1 fire at start next 2 turns; critical prevents HP recovery through end next turn. Silencer prevents verbal spellcasting through end next turn, critical also drops one held nonbonded item into its space; it can retrieve normally. Shiver gives Shaken through end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Hexroot gives-1 saves for 2 target turns; critical lets next weapon hit ignore resistance, never immunity, before end next turn.

Tier III: Voidspine deals 1d6 necrotic at start next 3 turns; critical adds-1 CON saves until end next turn, never changes ability scores/derived HP. Gravepetal makes target Unconscious until damage or end next turn, subject to shared hard-denial guard; critical also Prone and 3d6 poison immediate (resolve damage before unconsciousness). Neuroshock gives disadvantage on next DEX or WIS save before end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Wraithbane suppresses one observed bonus to AC (maximum 2) or damage resistance chosen before save until end next turn; critical prevents voluntary ethereal movement for duration. No core-engine, legendary action or creature-type removal; unsupported traits cannot be targeted.

Ordinary magical Thief techniques use the provisional minor-Weave RP pool and incur 1 D on use unless an ordinary spell says otherwise. Once per round, a Weave trick cast while hidden ignores its first point of Refrain Dissonance, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce base Dissonance or refund RP; a technique producing only its fixed 1 D receives no Refrain reduction unless it actually incurred Refrain. Arcane Trickster is still a Thief Hero, not an unrestricted full caster. Base 1–2, Rake Arch 3–9, chosen Arcane Trickster/Shadowblade/Blackguard Hero 10–20. Preserve advanced Arch gates: Distraction Tactics 13 and Crippling Strike 15 remain Arch selections obtainable after entering Hero. There is no automatic source Arch capstone; level 9 has its normal selection. Unseen Hand is Blackguard 20 automatic; the other paths receive the new level 20 finale below.
classes.protected: Once per round, a Weave trick cast while hidden ignores its first point of Refrain Dissonance; stealth changes delivery, not RP cost.
example: Thief 7, DEX 18, PB 3, S 2, M 4, Sneak 4d6, three doses prepared. Choose Bloodleech, Ashblood and Silencer. RP does not fuel mundane poison.

Turn 1 Bonus Action Apply Poison Bloodleech: doses 3→2 and coated attempts 2. Action weapon attack with adjacent ally qualifies Sneak. Hit deals weapon+4d6, CON save failure applies Bleed; coating attempts 2→1.
Target starts turn: takes 1d4 Bleed. No extra Sneak Attack, poison proc or RP recovery. It can still receive healing.
Turn 2 Feint uses Bonus Action; weapon hit at advantage can Sneak once. Final coating attempt 1→0; failed save refreshes Bloodleech duration instead of adding a second instance.
Turn 3 apply Ashblood, doses 2→1; miss spends first coated attempt without poison or Sneak damage. Tier II does not let this level 7 Thief select Hero abilities.
A long rest with kit refills to 3 total, rather than adding 3. No encounter transition refills doses.

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.effect: Upgrade automatic Sneak Attack: ignore 1 flat DR on the qualifying hit. Does not add another Sneak Attack or change its dice progression.

cards.name: Lockpick Mastery
cards.effect: Gain+5 on checks to pick nonmagical locks. Requires tools, access and ordinary time; success does not disable associated traps. Magic locks need their own permission.

cards.name: Stealth Chain
cards.effect: Gain+2 on next Stealth check. You still need cover/concealment and an action to Hide; the bonus does not automatically hide an observed attacker.

cards.name: Toxin Sense
cards.effect: Recognize presence of poison on sight or smell if perceptible. Action with kit identifies its game recipe on DC 12 INT+PB; sealed or magical substances may evade detection. Never grants immunity.

cards.name: Trap Intuition
cards.effect: Advantage on Perception/Investigation to notice physical traps and their triggers. Does not reveal every trap automatically or defeat concealed magic.

cards.name: Apply Poison
cards.effect: Coat using engine rules. Replaces ordinary Action coating. Damage or critical riders use the dose profile and required save; it is not a free weapon attack.

cards.name: Cunning Movement
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks; may pass through hostile occupied squares but not end there. Cannot cross impassable terrain or escape restraints.

cards.name: Disable Device
cards.frequency: At will; retries need changed approach
cards.effect: Make DEX+PB against its stated disarm DC; unknown DC defaults 15 for ordinary trap, 20 complex. Success disarms one accessible mechanism, failure by 5 triggers it. Does not automatically dispel magic.

cards.name: Feint
cards.target: One enemy within 10 ft that perceives you
cards.effect: CHA or DEX+PB deception check against target passive Insight. Success grants advantage on your next weapon attack against it. Failure gives no bonus; no mind-control or guaranteed critical.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.effect: Move half Speed and attempt Hide if the destination can conceal you. Movement produces no deliberate footfall noise but normal senses still apply. This Base feature is not teleportation.

cards.name: Combat Opener
cards.effect: Gain+5 initiative. Does not grant a surprise round, extra Action or automatic advantage against later actors.

cards.name: Ambush Focus
cards.target: One creature unaware of you before your attack
cards.effect: Add 2 damage to first weapon hit against it. Becoming unaware again requires legitimate hiding; invisible but detected is not automatically unaware.

cards.name: Evasion
cards.duration: Against DEX save effects dealing half on success
cards.effect: Take no damage on success and half on failure, unless incapacitated. Applies only to such DEX damage saves; cannot halve every spell or condition.

cards.name: Trap Sense
cards.effect: Gain+2 AC against trap attacks and+2 saves against traps. These bonuses do not detect or disable them and do not apply to ordinary monster attacks in a corridor.

cards.name: Shadow Stab
cards.target: One enemy critically hit by your melee weapon
cards.effect: After crit, move through target to adjacent empty space within 10 ft without opportunity attacks; apply Bleed 1d4 next 2 target turns. Movement requires open route, is not teleport and does not add another attack.

cards.name: Precision Feint
cards.effect: DEX+PB versus passive Insight; success target-2 AC against your next attack and cannot take Reactions until start your next turn. Failure no effect; cannot stack AC penalties from copies.

cards.name: Vanish
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack
cards.effect: Become Invisible even while observed. Ends immediately after you attack, deal damage or force a save. Does not erase sound/tracks, allow passage through walls or grant full untargetability.

cards.name: Analyze Weakness
cards.effect: Identify one of its visible defenses: armor, cover or exhibited damage resistance. Next weapon hit ignores 2 flat DR; does not invent vulnerabilities or reveal undisplayed secrets.

cards.name: Distraction Tactics
cards.target: One enemy within 30 ft that perceives you
cards.effect: Target WIS save; failure loses Reactions and next ally attack against it has advantage. Explicit Arch minimum 13 retained; no full Action theft.

cards.name: Crippling Strike
cards.target: One enemy hit by your Sneak Attack
cards.effect: Target CON save; failure Speed halved. Does not stack multiple slow fractions or deny teleport. Explicit Arch minimum 15 retained.

cards.name: Mage Sense
cards.effect: Detect whether it is active spell magic and its broad school if observable. Does not penetrate total cover, read spell descriptions or identify hidden casters automatically.

cards.name: Arcane Resistance
cards.effect: Gain+2 saves against spells. Not all supernatural monster abilities are spells; no resistance to damage unless separately granted.

cards.name: Illusory Stealth
cards.effect: A nonhostile illusion or concealment technique does not automatically break hiding. Components may still reveal your location and normal perception applies. Any attack, damage or forced save ends this exception.

cards.name: Spell Disruptor
cards.target: One enemy critically hit by your poisoned weapon
cards.effect: WIS save or suppress one observed temporary magical+AC bonus, maximum 2. No core class engine, innate trait, item destruction or blanket magic shutdown. Magical technique incurs 1 D unless cadence prevents it.

cards.name: Magebane Blade
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack with normal Sneak eligibility. On hit suppress one temporary spell buff of rank no greater than your spell-rank access through end next turn; higher rank remains. If none eligible, add 1d6 psychic. Magical technique 1 D.

cards.name: Pocket Illusion
cards.target: One attacker within 15 ft that you perceive
cards.effect: Before attack roll flash distracting illusion; WIS save or attack has disadvantage. No automatic miss or sustained Blindness. Magical technique 1 D, one Reaction.

cards.name: Flash Shift
cards.effect: Teleport 15 ft to perceived unoccupied space; gain+2 AC and+2 saves until duration ends. Full solid barrier blocks destination sight. Magical technique 1 D.

cards.name: Arcane Theft
cards.target: One enemy within 30 ft with observed spell buff
cards.effect: Target WIS save. Failure suppress one eligible temporary rank 1–3 buff for duration and gain only its printed AC bonus (max 2), Speed bonus(max 10 ft), or resistance to one damage type; choose before save. Does not copy actions, spells, resources, summons or capstones. Magical technique 1 D.

cards.name: Spell Snare
cards.effect: Place visible magical trap. First creature casting rank 1–3 spell while on/adjacent makes WIS save; failure spell fizzles after cost is paid. Trap ends either way. Higher spells unaffected and do not trigger; cannot counter legendary powers. Magical technique 1 D, maximum one trap.

cards.name: Ambusher's Grace
cards.target: Self after crit or defeating hostile enemy
cards.effect: Become Invisible; ends after your next attack, damage or forced save. You remain targetable if perceived and area effects work. No chain of unlimited untargetability from minions.

cards.name: Double Poison
cards.effect: You may apply two different doses using the same coating action. First critical hit may apply both with independent saves; noncritical hit applies your chosen one. Both doses consumed, total coated attack attempts remains 2.

cards.name: Persistent Bleed
cards.target: One enemy hit by your weapon

Explosive Handling makes throw Bonus Action; still only one bomb/regular turn. At 15 Danger Close automatically allows excluding yourself/allies. Safe Detonation grants this early. Consumes stock/allowance; no further destruction proc.

Deploy Action 2 RP within 15 ft, fixed ground, AC 12+PB HP 2 L, duration 3 rounds, concentration not required; destroyed do not refund fuel. All share command budget. Additional engine profiles unlocked 6: Rocket Tower commanded attack 60 ft target DEX save S d6 fire/half success to up to 2 creatures within 5 ft, maximum 3 shots; Decoy Dummy one foe 30 ft WIS save when deployed or disadvantage on next attack against others, destruction S fire to one adjacent enemy no chain; Blast Wall 10-by 5 ft blocks LOS and movement, climb cost 10 ft. Reduce Dissonance by that amount; the device is disabled and cannot move, attack, emit an aura or trigger effects until repaired or your next completed short rest. Its duration keeps ticking. paladinEngine: Charisma governs Oath DC/M and divine technique attacks. Weapon attacks use their ordinary Strength/Dexterity ability. Hit Die d10; all armor, shields, simple and martial weapons. Paladin has no Conviction or Oracle Revelation Charges. Lay on Hands is its own pool, 5×Paladin level, fully restored only by long rest. Ordinary spells and printed Smite fuel use the same Paladin Core V 2 RP pool; healing points never convert to RP.

Base progression is explicit rather than the ordinary 25-card template: at 1 automatically gain Lay on Hands, Divine Sense, Martial Proficiency, Divine Strike, Protective Stance and Sacred Touch. At 2 gain Righteous Challenge, Bolstering Presence, Fighting Style and ordinary Paladin spell access. At 3 swear ONE of ten Oaths; gain only its Smite modification, Aura and first Revelation spell. This Oath is the Arch specialization. At 10 enter Hero Oath Mastery of that SAME Oath; no second Oath or additional generic Hero tree. Signature Power unlocks 11, Final Gift 20. Oath Revelations automatically unlock 3/5/9/13/17, always known in addition to the shared spell repertoire, rank 1/2/3/4/5 respectively. Exact printed RP costs replace generic cost only if the card explicitly supplies them.

At 2 choose one Fighting Style: Defense +1 AC while armored; Dueling +2 damage to first one-handed melee hit on your own turn; Protection Reaction impose disadvantage on one attack against an adjacent ally when using a shield. At 3 Divine Health gives advantage on disease saves, not universal immunity. At 5 Extra Attack makes two attacks when taking the ordinary Attack Action; named attack techniques use their own counts. These three features reconcile preserved main-registry entries; other old level-table extras, including extra level 14 ASI and undefined free slot riders, are not stacked into this draft. ASI/feat at 4/8/12/16/19 follows general advancement once.

Divine Strike at 1: after one melee weapon hit on your regular turn, spend 1 RP to add S d6 radiant. At 2 this becomes Divine Smite: choose 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for(S+1)d8 radiant, once/own turn total. Oath 3 changes type/rider as its card states, never adds another copy of the base damage. Smite is not an ordinary spell, cannot be counterspelled or generically Overcast, and causes no Dissonance. A critical hit doubles Smite damage dice under ordinary rules, but never healing, resources or percentage copies.

One Oath aura, requires consciousness and no concentration. Radius 10 ft at 3, 15 ft at 6, 20 ft at 10, 30 ft at 15. Benefits affect up to 3 allies or 3 enemies as the Oath card states, chosen at start of your turn and changed next turn; they must stay within aura. At 6 choose one additional aura benefit for that day: allies+1 saves against fear/charm, or 1 flat DR against weapon damage. At 7 once/short rest when enemy damages an ally in aura, Reaction make one melee attack if in reach; may pay normal Smite cost even off turn, but total Smite maximum one per round from this reactive feature. At 10 aura persists until start of your next regular turn after incapacitation; then ends if still incapacitated. At 15 also grant selected allies+1 initiative while in aura when initiative is rolled; no retroactive turn changes.

At 17 Aura Surge once/short rest Bonus Action: until start next turn choose up to 3 allies in aura to gain S+M temporary HP and+1 saves. This bounded surge replaces vague doubling of every aura number. At 20 Divine Manifestation makes the aura active upon initiative without an action, radius 30 ft; it ignores ordinary Silence and terrain obstruction between allies but not antimagic explicitly suppressing divine powers, planar barriers or the consciousness rule. Source cannot-be-suppressed language is bounded explicitly. It grants no free Signature, Smite or Revelation spell.

Protected interface: Smite, Aura and Lay on Hands generate no Weave Dissonance. After a successful direct melee hit, your next Oath spell before end next turn generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0, consuming the benefit. No stacking, RP discount or Refrain reset. Oath Revelation spells and the five replacement Forbidden spells below are ordinary spells for strain, countering and concentration; signature powers and final gifts are Oath techniques unless expressly tagged otherwise.

Oath conduct clauses remain intact in source and Oath cards. The Director identifies a relevant clause and a knowingly chosen serious breach before applying a fall. A disagreement, failed roll, coerced act or unknown fact does not silently remove a character. A fall is an explicit story transition recorded with the player: choose the corresponding Oathbreaker inversion or pursue an agreed restoration scene. Preserve class level and already spent resources. Oathbreaker replaces its Oath Aura, Smite rider, Signature and Revelation list, rather than stacking both sets. Base martial abilities remain; Lay on Hands becomes Death Touch using the same current 5 L pool, with no refill on switching.

Death Touch baseline: Action melee divine attack PB+CHA; declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points before the attack from remaining Lay on Hands pool to deal that much necrotic damage (choose amount before roll; miss still spends declared points). Each Oath inversion may alter type or add its bounded rider; never copy innate traits, confiscate class engines or automatically execute a target. A listed inverted Signature is available only at 11 and replaces the ordinary Signature use, one/short rest. An inverted aura follows the same radius, target cap and timing. Oathbreaker 20 uses the new Black Manifestation common capstone instead of its original Final Gift.

The source names a Forbidden Spell List but does not supply five complete entries for each inversion. This pilot explicitly adds one shared five-spell replacement list (below), with each Oathbreaker using its inversion name as flavor. These are new test rules, not recovered historical spells. Choose the normal Oath package OR inverted package at a time. All later Oath prerequisites still use Paladin class level; the Oathbreaker label does not bypass 3/11/20 gates.

Oath integration limits: one paid Smite total per round, including the level-7 Reaction; one Oath-aura reactive event per round. Multiple damage-redirection options share one event per round unless Crown Undying expressly allows two. Apply original-target defenses once, then split actual damage; transferred damage cannot be mitigated again, reflected, redirected again or generate resources. This explicit rule supersedes wording that permits recipient defenses again.

Sustained Oath spell damage/healing zones use concentration, at most three pulses, and 1 RP upkeep after the first pulse unless a priced card expressly supplies a different finite cadence. Native Oath auras retain their printed passive cadence and target cap. Final auras last their stated finite duration and include their pulses. All hard-denial effects, including compelled Actions, share the common once/source/target/encounter guard; later failures only remove Reactions and reduce Speed by half for one turn.

An emergency Reaction whose trigger itself incapacitates you, such as Grace Reversal or Thorn Crown, may resolve before that incapacitation only if you had a Reaction available before the triggering event. This grants no other actions while incapacitated. Narrative labels such as oppressor require a specific act of captivity/coercion established in the scene, not an alignment or identity assumption.

The source ceiling’s half-pool-per-round Lay on Hands cap is a preserved alternative. This pilot instead uses maximum class level per ordinary Lay on Hands Action and the explicitly once-per-long-rest level-17 Wave that distributes the current remaining pool. No normal heal gains the Wave’s exception.
